labels: Did you always want to be a pumpkin farmer?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look, Spencer... I know I should be the last one offering anybody else dating advice.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's certainly true! You and Paige were a disaster!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Urp! Well, look over there! Some cups need organizing!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The point is... I'm not great at relationships...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I `do` know there's no way to start one without telling a girl how you feel.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] know there's no way to start one without telling a girl how you feel.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The longer you wait, the harder it gets. So... You may as well just go for it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know, man... Things didn't exactly work out great for me last time I tried to date someone...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sam basically put me in the friend zone after a few dates.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, I remember...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then she started chasing that pretty boy hipster, Nick...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...And even got back together with him after he broke her heart!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I admit, that was pretty rough...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe girls are just too dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Listen, man. Sam and $ALLISON are way different people...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And it's like Coach says, 'You can't make any tackles from the sidelines.'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I thought he was just explaining the rules.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's sometimes hard to tell...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The point is... Go for it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll think about it...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I did overhear you talking with $ALLISON about tutoring...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess I just assumed that was all a cover story so you'd get to spend time with her.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I `do` need some help... Especially in English!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] need some help... Especially in English!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean, have you heard me talk? I don't speak good!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think you mean, 'I don't speak `well'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think you mean, 'I don't speak [color=#e23b3b][i]well'.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... You're saying you don't like $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? No! I mean yes! I mean... Why? Did she say something about me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. Come on, man. It's obvious you like $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It `is?` You think she can tell?!
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#e23b3b][i]is?[/i][/color] You think she can tell?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Haha. Lucky for you, she's pretty clueless...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Phew.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But if you like her, don't you `want` her to know?
nodes.text_bbcode: But if you like her, don't you [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] her to know?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know! I guess... Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's the matter? You do like her right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know how I feel about... Feelings.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: See, you seem like the kind of girl who might sit around over-thinking things...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who should I date? Should I date anyone at all? Do I have a connection with this guy or that guy?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ah! I enjoy such existential questions!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: For example, does love exist or is it merely a social construct? Do `I` even exist? Is reality nothing but an illusion?
nodes.text_bbcode: For example, does love exist or is it merely a social construct? Do [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] even exist? Is reality nothing but an illusion?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Okay. I didn't realize we were dealing with `that` level of over-thinking.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Okay. I didn't realize we were dealing with [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] level of over-thinking.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The point is... Sometimes you just stop thinking and go for it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think I see your point...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...but `which` guy do I really want to date? Cameron... Or Spencer?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...but [color=#3b78e2][i]which[/i][/color] guy do I really want to date? Cameron... Or Spencer?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Spencer.
At football practice, Spencer watches sadly from the sidelines as the other guys play.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Go long!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Arm's looking good as ever, Nate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Naturally.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's the point of life if I can't even lay some smack down on the football field?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are you kidding? As water boys, we can play an essential role in the team's hydration!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I keep telling you! I'm not a water boy! I'm on the injured reserve!
Owen comes by...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... Thirsty...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Go on! Hand him a cup of water!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hydration...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine... Might as well make myself useful.
Spencer attempts to get up and hand Owen a cup of water...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoops!
He ends up falling over on his crutches, spilling water everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You okay, buddy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not by a longshot.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Last year I was the king of this field!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This year I can't even hand out water!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... There are always `other things` you can concentrate on.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... There are always [color=#e23b3b][i]other things[/i][/color] you can concentrate on.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Other things,' huh? I guess you must mean...
$ALLISON continues learning about Paige's dating strategy.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...so you just have the waiter write his number on a coaster and slip it into your purse!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And if your guy asks, tell him you're looking for waiters for your next birthday party!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not sure how this particular scenario applies to my situation...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding? In this scenario, Cameron is the waiter! `Now` do you see?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? In this scenario, Cameron is the waiter! [color=#3b78e2][i]Now[/i][/color] do you see?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think I'm leaving this lesson more confused than ever...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is hopeless. I'm going to do a five-minute makeup touchup, then I'm coming right back for your next lesson.
Paige leaves.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $ALLISON, wait... Let me give you just `one` piece of advice, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: $ALLISON, wait... Let me give you just [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] piece of advice, okay?

nodes.text: Paige continues her story about the waiter at the yacht party and begins to draw an elaborate flow chart explaining her strategy...
When Paige's back is turned, Kimi whispers in your ear.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Honestly, I don't have the best track record with guys...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It took me forever to get together with Kevin, mostly because I was so unsure how I felt about him.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm beginning to understand the feeling of uncertainty that you're describing.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Even now, I'm sometimes unsure what my feelings are...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But I'm still glad Kevin and I got together.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Even if we don't work out in the long term, I've still learned a lot from dating him, and we've had some great times!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That... Actually makes a lot of sense.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If inexperience is my chief difficulty, the only solution is to... Get some experience!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Exactly!
In the meantime, Paige finishes her story about the waiter and the yacht.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...and if your guy gets jealous, just dump him the next day!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... Right. Great advice!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now stay put. I'm going to do a five-minute makeup touchup. Then I'm coming right back for your next lesson.
Paige leaves.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just one more thing, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So I'm 'Mature'?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure. Think about it...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Have you ever threatened to kill a guy because he accidentally brought you a nonfat soy latte but forgot the simple syrup?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't even drink coffee!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And have you ever thrown a hysterical fit because you caught your boyfriend talking to another girl at the mall...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...and then it turns out that girl is his 35-year-old aunt?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: First, I've never had a boyfriend. And second, no. That has never happened.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: In that case, my dear, you are officially mature. Put-together. Low-maintenance.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess I am.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yep. By high school girl standards? Absolutely.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Even `I` once snapped Kevin's copy of 'Call of Battle 4' in half when he forgot the two month anniversary of our second kiss!
nodes.text_bbcode: Even [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] once snapped Kevin's copy of 'Call of Battle 4' in half when he forgot the two month anniversary of our second kiss!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So you're 'mature', $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But you're also hopelessly ill-equipped for dating!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I must agree with you on that point... Any advice would be appreciated!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's just what I wanted to hear!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's time for some flirting bootcamp.
Two minutes later, $ALLISON and Kimi sit in a classroom as Paige paces in front of them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pop-quiz. You're standing at your locker when Cameron comes up and asks you to lunch.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you do, $ALLISON? `What do you do?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you do, $ALLISON? [color=#3b78e2][i]What do you do?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Check my schedule and help him pick a restaurant?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Wrong!` You tell him that you already have plans with Trevor!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Wrong![/i][/color] You tell him that you already have plans with Trevor!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Who's Trevor?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `There is no Trevor!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]There is no Trevor![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I get it. Trevor is girl code for, 'You're not the only hot guy chasing after me.'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Did I give you permission to speak?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Did I give you permission to speak?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay. Another scenario. You're at a yacht party with your guy when a hot waiter starts getting flirty...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think I recognize this question from 'Rich Girl' magazine!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Pssst... $ALLISON. I'm not sure this advice is really going to help you. Want to hear a few of `my` tips instead?
nodes.text_bbcode: Pssst... $ALLISON. I'm not sure this advice is really going to help you. Want to hear a few of [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] tips instead?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well...

options.label: I think Paige is making some good points.
I'd like to get your perspective, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Excellent. The number one thing I look for in a student is a willingness to learn.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Learning is one of my favorite things to do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See... Phrases like that aren't going to fly if you want to land Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, if I'm so bad at this, what makes you think I've got a chance at all?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's simple, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You may be naive, nerdy, and socially inept...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But Cameron seems to think of you as `mature!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But Cameron seems to think of you as [color=#3b78e2][i]mature![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... Are you saying I'm jealous of you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Not exactly... But it seems to me you may be frustrated with your own romantic situation.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And just what `situation` are you talking about?
nodes.text_bbcode: And just what [color=#3b78e2][i]situation[/i][/color] are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... No situation. No situation at all!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I mean, it's not like it's totally obvious that you still have feelings for Owen and are too immature to admit it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `What did you just say?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What did you just say?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It seems unnecessary to repeat my sentence.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let me tell you something about `maturity,` $ALLISON.
nodes.text_bbcode: Let me tell you something about [color=#3b78e2][i]maturity,[/i][/color] $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's the one thing you've got going for you when it comes to Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just so you know, Cameron has kind of a bad reputation...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But I went out with him once, and he turned out to be a total gentleman!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's a hot bad boy with a heart of gold!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This is... A lot of information.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Don't look now, but he's walking this way!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey there, $ALLISON. How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's going swimmingly.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey. No fair stealing my line. I'm the `swimmer` here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey. No fair stealing my line. I'm the [color=#e23b3b][i]swimmer[/i][/color] here.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't believe you have a trademark on aquatic terminology.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Well, I'll forgive you just this once, but you owe me one now.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I hardly see how I'm in your debt.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Come on! You're kicking a man when he's down. You `know` I just broke up with Veronica...
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on! You're kicking a man when he's down. You [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] I just broke up with Veronica...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You... May have mentioned that last time we spoke.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah... Let's just say I'm looking for someone a little more... Mature.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That seems like a good course of action.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Anyway, see you around, $ALLISON.
Cameron smiles and walks away.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That was...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Horrible!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Where did `you` come from?
nodes.text_bbcode: Where did [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] come from?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've been listening to this whole pathetic conversation, trying to bite my tongue.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lately, I've been trying not to care about dances or flirting or boys...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I just can't stand by and accept this level of `incompetence!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I just can't stand by and accept this level of [color=#3b78e2][i]incompetence![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That seems like a bit of an exaggeration.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding? $ALLISON, if you don't improve your flirting skills ASAP, you're going to miss out on dating the hottest guy at school!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: My conversational methods seem to be holding me in good stead so far.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm trying to help! Are you ready to listen?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, apparently...

options.label: You feel a need to live vicariously through me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I knew it! My `girl sense` has been tingling ever since the Autumn Festival!
nodes.text_bbcode: I knew it! My [color=#3b78e2][i]girl sense[/i][/color] has been tingling ever since the Autumn Festival!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It `has?`
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]has?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I saw your whole conversation! It's so obvious you have a crush...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: On `Cameron!`
nodes.text_bbcode: On [color=#3b78e2][i]Cameron![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Allison looks across the crowd of swimmers, to where Cameron is hanging out with his senior friends.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I must admit, my heart is racing, and for some reason my palms are sweating.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah. That's called a crush.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Could I possibly have feelings for both Spencer `and` Cameron?
nodes.text_bbcode: Could I possibly have feelings for both Spencer [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: O.M.G., you're totally blushing! I knew you liked Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for letting me in on your little secret! I feel like we're totally bonding!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... Good. Yes. Good.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: O.M.G.! You really are clueless, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that a thing people have been saying about me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean... I'm just saying you're not seeing the obvious.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: There's a guy that totally seems interested in you!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is it that obvious?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course! It's plain as day!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Cameron` totally has a thing for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cameron[/i][/color] totally has a thing for you!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron?
Allison looks across the crowd of swimmers, to where Cameron is hanging out with his senior friends.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I must admit, my heart is racing, and for some reason my palms are sweating.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah. That's called a crush.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Could I possibly have feelings for both Spencer `and` Cameron?
nodes.text_bbcode: Could I possibly have feelings for both Spencer [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: O.M.G., you're totally blushing! I knew you liked Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I just wish you would have fessed up to it in the first place! I thought we were friends!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I apologize?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Great move, $ALLISON! Time alone with Spencer should afford you a perfect chance to assess your feelings!
After detention is over...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did you hear about the dance? Did you `hear` about the dance? `Did you hear about the dance?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you hear about the dance? Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]hear[/i][/color] about the dance? [color=#3b78e2][i]Did you hear about the dance?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course. I was standing right next to you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm `so` excited! I wonder how Kevin will officially ask me...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] excited! I wonder how Kevin will officially ask me...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe he'll write 'Kimi, will you go to the dance with me?' in rocks on the side of a mountain...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...And then have me look at the message through binoculars!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That sounds... Elaborate!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Or maybe he'll stand up in front of everyone in the cafeteria and ask me in the form of a poem!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Unless that's uncool? Is that uncool?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are these... Convoluted proposals... Really a part of the school's pre-dance ritual?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: For sure! Ooooh! Look over there!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Looks like swim practice just got out! And now Ben is asking Emily to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily, friends, if you would please follow me, there's a question I need to ask...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: A question, huh?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now, if you would please follow me and look up at the sky...
As Emily and the crowd watch in awe, Ben takes out a book of matches and lights several large rockets!
They fly up into the sky, exploding in a shower of sparks.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: O.M.G.! Pretty fireworks! I love the blue ones!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's the copper chloride! I really hope we get to see some barium chloride ones!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $ALLISON? English?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry! Green ones. I meant green ones.
The final firework explodes, forming the words 'Emily, Dance? -Ben'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Of course I'll go with you!
Ben and Emily embrace.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That was good, right? Good not great. Like, I'm sure Kevin can top that.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh, yes. Almost certainly.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What about you? Do you think anyone will ask you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You'd really help me?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course! I'd love to tutor you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's like the two of us... At a desk?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That would certainly facilitate the tutoring process.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That sounds... Uh, great! I could really use the help.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I don't pull at least a `3.0 GPA,` my scholarship for the Steelman Program gets revoked.
nodes.text_bbcode: If I don't pull at least a [color=#e23b3b][i]3.0 GPA,[/i][/color] my scholarship for the Steelman Program gets revoked.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I helped you get that scholarship... There's no way I'm going to let you lose it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cool. Thanks.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm happy to help!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No offense, but if my doctors can't help, I'm not too sure what you can do.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Physical therapy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's a broken bone. It just needs time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You don't own a time machine, right?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Unfortunately no.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That was a joke.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Right! Of course!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I feel a little stupid... This is embarrassing and unpleasant.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No way! There's no way you could be stupid, like, ever!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually, I was thinking of asking for your help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: My... Help?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I don't pull at least a `3.0 GPA,` my scholarship into the Steelman Program gets revoked.
nodes.text_bbcode: If I don't pull at least a [color=#e23b3b][i]3.0 GPA,[/i][/color] my scholarship into the Steelman Program gets revoked.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But with your huge brain and all, I thought maybe you could help tutor me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I'd be happy to help!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Awkward silence!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Okay, Troublemakers! Time to sit down!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thanks for the save, Ms. Lee!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's great to have you all in here, putting this room to good use!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: This `used` to serve as a secret, extra-special teacher's lounge before the state government crushed their union and took away everything they hold dear!
nodes.text_bbcode: This [color=#3b78e2][i]used[/i][/color] to serve as a secret, extra-special teacher's lounge before the state government crushed their union and took away everything they hold dear!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Since the rest of the faculty chose never to `tell` me about this place, I'm calling this just desserts!
nodes.text_bbcode: Since the rest of the faculty chose never to [color=#3b78e2][i]tell[/i][/color] me about this place, I'm calling this just desserts!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe we're stuck here all year.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Think of it as a quiet hour to do your homework and improve your grades!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But I'm  already on track for a 4.0...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But why settle for that?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually, since the school doesn't officially count an 'A+' toward one's cumulative GPA, a 4.0 is the highest...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's like your lips just keep moving and I keep not caring!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: The point is, you're here to study.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now, let's be honest. Am I going to actually 'monitor' you? Or 'pay attention' to what you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Not at all! No way I'm wasting afternoons hanging out here!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: So the deal is simple. Don't get in trouble, and we'll get along just fine!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sounds like a fair deal to me.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Completely! And there's even more good news...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now that your expulsion has been repealed, you've all been cleared to participate in `school activities!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now that your expulsion has been repealed, you've all been cleared to participate in [color=#3b78e2][i]school activities![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So I `could` play football again. If not for this stupid leg.
nodes.text_bbcode: So I [color=#e23b3b][i]could[/i][/color] play football again. If not for this stupid leg.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That doesn't mean you can't contribute! I'm trying out for the 'water boy' position. You should too!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Water boy' isn't a `position!`
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Water boy' isn't a [color=#e23b3b][i]position![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Does that mean we can participate in the Homecoming Dance?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You bet. Provided you can get a date.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Squeeee!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now that's pretty exciting.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you think, $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I have been known to dance from time to time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've trained in both Waltz and Jitterbug!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A high school dance is more about moving your body to sick beats.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: 'Sick beats'?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like, songs by cool rappers and DJs? Like Snoop Beary Bear? Pitdogg? DJ DangerRatt?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Do they all have animal names?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All the good ones do!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I'm open to trying out a new dance style...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Definitely! And it's even better if you go with someone you really like!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Even with my leg busted I'm still looking forward to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah! I bet it'll be great! So... You're going to go?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Time to study, everyone! See you later!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... I should probably go study now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yep! But, uh, first I have something to ask you...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've actually been meaning to mention it to you all morning...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's about the `Steelman Program!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's about the [color=#e23b3b][i]Steelman Program![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Huh? The Steelman Program? `That's` what's on your mind?
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh? The Steelman Program? [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] what's on your mind?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pretty much just that!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... See. So what happened with the Steelman Program?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was really looking forward to the camp...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's coming up next summer, and it's my best shot at learning the moves that'll turn me into a college-caliber player.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But with my grades `and` my injury. It's not looking good. Those jerks might yank the scholarship!
nodes.text_bbcode: But with my grades [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] my injury. It's not looking good. Those jerks might yank the scholarship!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why didn't you just say so?! This is a perfect chance for me to pay you back!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I can totally help you with...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. I've never seen you tongue-tied.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A false accusation! If anything, I'm loose-tongued!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Does that mean you tell people's secrets?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's not what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's like I was saying... `Crush`ed ice in your snow cone!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like I was saying... [color=#e23b3b][i]Crush[/i][/color]ed ice in your snow cone!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't have a snow cone, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Skittering skeletons! That was a scary face!
Erik slowly backs away to the other side of the room.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did Erik say something about a crush?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Crush? I heard 'slush'! Who ever knows what Erik is talking about, right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... Right.
A few seconds later, though, Spencer's smile fades, and he looks down at the ground.

nodes.text: Spencer? Is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Yeah. Totally fine.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pretty sure.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good to hear!
Score Up!

nodes.text: And, uh, what about you? How was your day?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Great. Yep. Great. Awesomeness.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just... Perfect.

nodes.speaker: Spencer

nodes.text: At the end of a long school day, $ALLISON leaves her last class...
...And heads straight for detention.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Woo hee! I can't wait for detention! I've been looking forward to this all day!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Five friends! One room! Mandatory attendance! It's like completing my bucket list in one swoop!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This isn't precisely the manner in which I imagined I'd be spending the halcyon days of my youth...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But I agree. At least we now have several friends with whom we can pass the hours.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Though I must admit, there's one face I'm looking forward to seeing above all others...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You mean Spencer, don't you? Sounds like someone's got a little `crush`ed ice in her snow cone!
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean Spencer, don't you? Sounds like someone's got a little [color=#e23b3b][i]crush[/i][/color]ed ice in her snow cone!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I merely meant to voice my pleasure regarding his return from the hospital!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whatever you say!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Jumping beans! This place is even better than I remember.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Chairs with fabric instead of plastic... and windows without a half-inch of grime!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I must admit, the lack of exposed pipes and missing ceiling tiles is impressive.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I could get used to this place.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not bad for a room in a public high school.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's nice to finally hang out somewhere that doesn't look like the 'before' segment of a home improvement show!
Spencer awkwardly navigates with his crutches in between two couches.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stupid! Couches!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Poor Spencer... Look at him leaning on his crutches!
$ALLISON approaches Spencer, as he sits alone on a couch.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sup, Red. How's things?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Things are...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay... So the next word is 'infatuated'. Do you remember what that means?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure! 'Possessed by intense passion'!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Good! How about, 'Connoted'?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's a fancy way of saying 'implied'.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes! You're really getting it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think we're good on vocab for the moment...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Those all sound great! Now... Try to use one in a sentence!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How about... $ALLISON, I think you're... Radiant.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You... Do? Wait! I mean... Good sentence!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's like I was saying poetry!
Overhead, a cloud moves across the sun.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's getting kind of cold... I should head back inside...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: In, like `two` minutes, tops. Maybe three.
nodes.text_bbcode: In, like [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] minutes, tops. Maybe three.

nodes.text: Fifteen minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stupid... Nerves. Okay. Here goes nothing. I'm ready as I'll ever be!
Spencer walks into the student lounge...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: O.M.G.! Spencer! Where have you been?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, just, you know, out?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You missed the `big event!`

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Big... Event?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Cameron and $ALLISON, silly! He asked her to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... How'd you get over it. The nerves, I mean?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: The truth is... Getting nervous is half the fun. If you're anxious, it means you care.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess that makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So you feel that doubt, that uncertainty... You feel it to its core. You enjoy it, even.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Then you walk inside and ask whoever you like to Homecoming.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Huh. Not a bad pep-talk.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Thanks... I've been kind of giving it to myself.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... You mean `you're` about to ask someone to the dance too?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... You mean [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] about to ask someone to the dance too?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yep... And I have no idea what she'll say.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds like we're both in the same boat.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Anyway... I might as well get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, good luck!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Thanks, man. I'll need it.
Cameron walks inside.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know, he's actually a pretty cool guy...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wonder who he's asking to the dance.

nodes.speaker: Cameron

$ALLISON can feel her knees shaking!
$ALLISON heads over to the restroom door and knocks lightly on it...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Kimi, it's me, $ALLISON, I'd really like to--

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: GO AWAY!
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?
$ALLISON approaches Erik...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hey, Erik, I heard you moaning just now. Has something upset you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It has, actually! Thanks for coming to me right away... I'm usually an afterthought!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't think of you that way...
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?
$ALLISON sits down near Paige's side of the couch...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Psst! Paige, is there anything I can do for you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You've done enough already! Now I'm committed to taking Lee to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why don't you just tell Owen the truth?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because as soon as he knows I'm waiting for him, it'll seem like I want to get back together!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But aren't you together?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! But not officially `together` together! We're not together for real!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! But not officially [color=#3b78e2][i]together[/i][/color] together! We're not together for real!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's possible this relationship is too complicated for me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, so maybe butt out then!
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?
$ALLISON sits down near Owen's side of the couch...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Psst! Owen, is there anything I can do for you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think so! Unless you know how to keep `her` away from me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think so! Unless you know how to keep [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] away from me.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I know about you and Paige... Your secret.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You... You do?
$ALLISON nods.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why don't you just admit that you want to get back together?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No offense, but you don't know how Paige works. Admitting that would destroy everything.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's possible that this relationship is too complicated for me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for trying to help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sure...
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?
$ALLISON walks over to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I just wanted to see if I could help with--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't need help! I just need to get through this exercise. By myself.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is this because I'm attending the dance with--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why are you still talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Fine. Sorry for wanting to help!
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi...
Kimi peeks at Kevin's hands, noticing that they're empty...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The fireworks must be outside! With the balloons! And the horse!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh, not sure what that's about, but the other nerds just reminded me there's a dance or something coming up...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: ...We're going together, right?
Kimi's mouth drops.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Here comes the show in three, two, one...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No desirability, no confidence, nothing elaborate! That was `officially` the worst ask-out in the history of recorded ask-outs!
nodes.text_bbcode: No desirability, no confidence, nothing elaborate! That was [color=#3b78e2][i]officially[/i][/color] the worst ask-out in the history of recorded ask-outs!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You scored, like, a zero!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh... What are you talking about?
Kimi looks back at Paige and $ALLISON, her face turning red...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm talking about the Homecoming Dance...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Which I stressed was super important to me!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...You're supposed to do something big and romantic, something that proves just how much you actually care about me...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I care about you...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't... I don't know that you do.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: This whole time I thought you were distant with me because you were preparing this big romantic gesture...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But now I'm finding out that you were `just distant` with me...
nodes.text_bbcode: But now I'm finding out that you were [color=#3b78e2][i]just distant[/i][/color] with me...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Who cares about this stuff anyway? It's lame.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, it isn't lame! What's lame is you playing video games `all` the time!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it isn't lame! What's lame is you playing video games [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the time!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I went to `one` LAN match!
nodes.text_bbcode: I went to [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] LAN match!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, one `this week!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, one [color=#3b78e2][i]this week![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And I'm perfectly fine with LAN matches with the guys, but only if that means you give me time too!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I give you time!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Playing video games with me in the room does `not` count, Kevin!
nodes.text_bbcode: Playing video games with me in the room does [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] count, Kevin!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You know what? Forget it! I'm tired of being a third wheel!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It means we're through! I just broke up with you! Now you can play games while I go to the dance with someone who actually cares!
Kimi storms off, straight into the Student Lounge, $ALLISON and Paige trailing behind her!
Before they enter, Paige stops $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When we get in there, find out who Owen's going to the dance with!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm a friend and I need to know, okay?!
Before $ALLISON can reply, Paige marches off into the lounge!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And I thought things would be `more` mature in high school...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I thought things would be [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] mature in high school...

nodes.text: In the Student Lounge, Owen, Spencer, and Erik all have stunned looks on their faces.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where'd Kimi go?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She called all of us 'idiot pig dummies' and then slammed the bathroom door shut.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did something happen?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: She just broke up with Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Should one of us talk to her?

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: The next person who says anything to me's going to get a taste of bathroom tile!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe not right now...
A few moments later...
Kimi is still in the bathroom, Spencer is doing physical therapy exercises back and forth across the room.
Erik is staring at his phone, and Paige and Owen are studying on opposite ends of the couch...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, Owen, with whom are you attending the dance?
Owen immediately glances at Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... I know I'm going with... Someone.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You are? Who?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I haven't actually asked anyone yet. Why? Who are you going with?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, Paige hasn't actually--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lee! I'm going with Lee!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? Popped collar guy?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you care who I take?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't!
Owen pulls a book from his backpack and flips it open, turning his back on Paige!
Meanwhile, Erik is making strange whimpering noises while staring at his phone...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oooooog...
And Spencer is getting increasingly frustrated by his injured leg!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr! Stupid! Leg!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Seems like everyone's got a problem right now... Who can I actually help?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Yes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Calm down, Kiss Whisperer.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tip one! Close your eyes! No one wants to kiss a bug-eyed alien!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Closed eyes are also a way of signaling to him to make a move.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That makes sense...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooh! Tip two! Head tilt! Don't forget!
Kimi tilts her head slightly to demonstrate.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why is that necessary when--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tip three! Once your lips touch, open your mouth `a little,` like you just heard something surprising but not shocking.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tip three! Once your lips touch, open your mouth [color=#3b78e2][i]a little,[/i][/color] like you just heard something surprising but not shocking.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is too much.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, that's good!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, there's one more tip.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, one obvious tip.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Relax. Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's a hard one because you're going to feel, like, a thousand pounds of nervous, but it'll make the whole experience `way` better!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's a hard one because you're going to feel, like, a thousand pounds of nervous, but it'll make the whole experience [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] better!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You'll be like, 'Ohmygosh! This is great!', and he'll be like, 'Yeah. Awesome. $ALLISON's the best kisser!' Trust us.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I will. Thank you for helping me.
Just then, Kevin turns the corner...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeeep! This is it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I do! I do!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Do `not` wear braces and kiss a guy who is also wearing braces!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] wear braces and kiss a guy who is also wearing braces!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because yes, your faces will get stuck together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Cause that applies here.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She could get braces later on in life...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: More relevant. Don't kiss directly after an Italian meal. So much garlic breath.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ew.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I kissed a guy once who darted his tongue in and out like a lizard. Don't do that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Super ew.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then again, `I` kissed a guy who didn't actually move his mouth. It was like making out with a statue.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then again, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] kissed a guy who didn't actually move his mouth. It was like making out with a statue.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hahaha! Well I made out with a guy who...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: These are funny stories, but I am not learning anything...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I am sorry to interrupt but--
Just then, Kevin turns the corner...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeeep! This is it!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Looks like I missed my chance...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess that means Paige and Owen really `are` secretly dating!
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess that means Paige and Owen really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] secretly dating!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Anyway, enough of that! Let's get back to... Cam$ALLISONon? $ALLISONeron? Camer$ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't say any of those names ever again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whatever. Check this out!
Kimi pulls out a sheet of paper from her folder...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was `so` bored in Mr. Dean's class, so I started ranking all the different ask-outs!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] bored in Mr. Dean's class, so I started ranking all the different ask-outs!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Totally normal.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: In the end, I gave Cameron's ask-out a 45 out of 50.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It scored high in most categories... Desirability, confidence, surprise... But fell short of perfect because it wasn't very elaborate since he just asked you directly.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Honestly, it just felt nice to be asked.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course! And a 45 is a great score! I'm just so excited for whatever Kevin's planned!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's been so distant lately...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I `know` that means he's been working on something `big!` Maybe skywriting?! Or hundreds of balloons?! Or something involving a horse?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] that means he's been working on something [color=#3b78e2][i]big![/i][/color] Maybe skywriting?! Or hundreds of balloons?! Or something involving a horse?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeep! Whatever it is, I just know that it'll be `so` special! A 50 for sure!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eeeep! Whatever it is, I just know that it'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] special! A 50 for sure!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatevs...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What about you, $ALLISON, are you ready for the dance?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I believe so.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron will be meeting me there. Is that standard?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Standard for most guys? No. Standard Cameron? Yes.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Additionally, I've acquired shoes, a suitable dress, and what I believe are all the prerequisite accessories for a dance.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you also find a vacuum? Because you're really sucking the fun out of this...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry, this is all new to me. I've never attended a dance.
Kimi and Paige immediately stop walking.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Never...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Been...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...To a dance?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Never. I mean, I was more focused on studies in middle school...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Says no one ever!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Wait... Have you ever been `kissed?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh! Wait... Have you ever been [color=#3b78e2][i]kissed?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I haven't... Is that a part of going to a dance? Because that would explain my day.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, now that everyone knows I'm going to the dance with Cameron, today's been... A little weird...
Before school...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You don't even know how lucky you are! Kissing Cameron is like having a motorcycle in your mouth.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that... Desirable?
In Mr. Dean's class...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I heard you're going with Cameron. Do `not` tell him I said this as it goes against everything I'm about...
nodes.text_bbcode: I heard you're going with Cameron. Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] tell him I said this as it goes against everything I'm about...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But there are three stages in your life... Before Cameron kisses you...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: While Cameron's kissing you...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And after Cameron kisses you...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are you in the before stage or the after stage?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: All I know is I'm not in the best stage...
At lunch...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh yeah, we made out for an hour once. That was the same day that I lost my credit card and fell into some mud in my favorite skirt...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Best day of my life.
The present...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A `very` weird day, actually...
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] weird day, actually...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, those girls know what they're talking about...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Don't tell me there's also a rankings list of which boys are the best kissers...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... There `might` be.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... There [color=#3b78e2][i]might[/i][/color] be.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? You have a serious problem, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe I do, but `Kimi's Pecking Order` is coming in handy right now, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I do, but [color=#3b78e2][i]Kimi's Pecking Order[/i][/color] is coming in handy right now, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And since I know both of you are dying to know, Cameron is far and away the `best` kisser at Twin Branches!
nodes.text_bbcode: And since I know both of you are dying to know, Cameron is far and away the [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] kisser at Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If Cameron's the best kisser, then I suppose I should feel lucky...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Honestly, I'm just nervous.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh. That's because you don't know anything about kissing!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The first time I kissed a guy, I slammed my face into his so hard, I actually bruised my mouth!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hahaha!

options.label: Do you have any more stories?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Like they're, um, keeping a secret?
Kimi whirls toward Paige!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! A secret! What secret?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's no secret! We broke up! We hate each other! That's it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then why were you smiling that day like $ALLISON said?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't remember, but I was probably happy after winning that fight with Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now can we please move on? I'm not made of glass, but the more I think about him and me actually dating, the more nauseous I get...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But, do you remember when he first kissed you over that ice cream?!... Ooh! Or when he rode in on that horse on the beach?! Or my favorite Powen moment was when he...
...As Kimi prattles on, Paige whispers to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Real smooth.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I apologize. I've never been very good at distorting the truth.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, then shut up about it from now on.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Like they're... Oh, hey, we didn't talk about what dress you're planning on wearing, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I `was` thinking about designing my own, of course!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] thinking about designing my own, of course!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But then I saw this one dress in the mall that was to die for! I mean `to. Die. For.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But then I saw this one dress in the mall that was to die for! I mean [color=#3b78e2][i]to. Die. For.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Picture this. Bright cutout purple top with a black high-low skirt! Plus...
As Kimi describes her dress, Paige whispers to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks for that.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No problem. Your secret's safe.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Keep it that way...
You are now playing as $ALLISON.
In the hallway after school, $ALLISON, Kimi, and Paige are walking toward detention. All around them, students are buzzing about the Homecoming Dance!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess Homecoming is kind of a monumental occasion...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! It's huge! And I cannot believe Cameron asked you to the dance! That was like amazing and just... `Ahhhh!` The best!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding?! It's huge! And I cannot believe Cameron asked you to the dance! That was like amazing and just... [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhh![/i][/color] The best!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So Cameron asked her... What's the big deal?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're just upset because no guy's asked you yet.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've been asked plenty. But only by gross guys. The kind with velcro wallets.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If I might interject... I thought 'gross' was kind of your preferred type. I mean, that's what you're always calling Owen, and--
Kimi pinches $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think it's obvious who Paige won't be going with... A guy we `shouldn't mention by name.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think it's obvious who Paige won't be going with... A guy we [color=#3b78e2][i]shouldn't mention by name.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, right...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. You don't have to treat me like I'm made of glass. Owen and I are...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Mortal enemies?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Well, it's way, `way` more complicated than that...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Well, it's way, [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] more complicated than that...

nodes.speaker: Allison

Before long...

nodes.text: That whole time we were saying goodbye, he never once shouted at me or ridiculed me or shooed me away with a broom, so I'd call it a success!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You don't know my dad like I do. He's a really quiet person. He may not have said anything aloud... But he said it with his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What makes you say that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't you remember the last time I saw your dad?
Days earlier...
Erik walks Delilah down the dirt road from the bus stop to her front porch.
As they reach the door, Delilah turns to him, smiling shyly.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Thanks for walking me back to my house. I usually don't get home so late, but 4H Club ran extra long today.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My pleasure. I had a great time walking with you... But then again, I always have a great time with you.
Delilah smiles, a rosy color flushing to her cheeks. She looks into Erik's eyes, when suddenly...
`SHHHK! SHHHK! SHHHK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SHHHK! SHHHK! SHHHK![/b]

nodes.text: Just then, a scraping noise sounds from the porch beside them! The two stop in their tracks!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What was that?

The two turn to find Delilah's father in a rocking chair at the far end of the porch, his face half-shrouded in shadow. In his hands he holds a small block of wood, whittling away at it with a long, gleaming knife!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: D...Daddy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mr. Horner! Good evening! Didn't see you there!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Go on inside, Delilah.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He's right, it's getting a little chilly out here.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Best get going, son.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good idea! Can't be wandering around after dark! G'night Delilah! See ya, Mr. Horner!
Erik turns and walks away, whistling a jaunty tune. All the while, Mr. Horner watches Erik with locked, scowling eyes...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think that memory should reassure you.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: How, exactly?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Clearly, your dad thinks I'm...
Erik wraps his arms around Delilah. He squeezes her, and she squeezes back with a giggle.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee hee, Erik! You know my dad is strict! What if he saw us?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I couldn't help it! You smell like flowers!
Delilah grins and blushes, but steps away, looking over her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Besides, we have nothing to worry about!
Erik leans in, lips puckered... But Delilah backs away in shock!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Erik! What are you doing! My dad's just inside! What if he saw us?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But... I thought there was nothing to worry about!

nodes.title: A Troublemakers Thanksgiving
nodes.subtitle: Can Erik impress Delilah's no-nonsense father?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Erik.
The Troublemakers gather on the dirt road out in front of the Horner Farm, following Erik as he makes his way to the front gate.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for coming with me, guys. I was a little nervous when Delilah invited me over to her farm for Thanksgiving dinner.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Her dad's a pretty intense guy, but I think I've made some progress with him lately. Plus, if you guys have my back, I'm sure I'll be fine as a fiddle!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No problem, man. We're happy to help.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Speak for yourself, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...But I suppose I didn't have anything better to do, so here I am!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, as long as free food is involved, I'm there!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah! Besides, the six of us haven't done anything together since Homecoming!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If it's all the same to you, I'd rather not talk about Homecoming.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It, uh, didn't go well for you, $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That would be a gross understatement. Let's just say that Cameron is not who I thought he was.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well... I for one had a `great` time at Homecoming with Lee.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I for one had a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] time at Homecoming with Lee.

nodes.text: Paige flashes a glance toward Owen, searching for his reaction.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, right... yeah, Homecoming was awesome! Maria and I had a blast!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, `my` night was the opposite of blast. It was a gravitational implosion. And yet here we are, still talking about it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] night was the opposite of blast. It was a gravitational implosion. And yet here we are, still talking about it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well... Maybe you just need to get your mind off things.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And what better way to do that than with some grub?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suppose so...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...At least a turkey won't try to decide what's best for me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's true. Turkeys are noble, nonjudgmental creatures.
Just then, the farmhouse door opens, and Delilah walks out to greet the Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hi Erik! Hi everyone! It's great to have you all over for Thanksgiving.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Delilah! Hello!
Delilah beckons Erik aside, away from the group. Erik straightens his posture and smooths his hair. As Delilah approaches, he leans in and...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What about you, Daddy?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: I'm thankful for this perfect dinner.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Perfect? But I ruined the turkey! I was hoping to make a delicious dinner just like Mom always made for you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: They weren't always delicious. Your mom burnt the first five turkeys she ever made.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: She did?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: To a crisp. But food's not what makes a dinner perfect. It's the `people.`
nodes.text_bbcode: To a crisp. But food's not what makes a dinner perfect. It's the [color=#e23b3b][i]people.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: And it looks like you've gathered a fine group of people here today.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: And this one...
Mr. Horner points a thumb at Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: ...He's a tough kid. I like 'im.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Delilah stands and wraps her arms around her father in a tight hug.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Tough'? Are we still talking about Erik here?
Later that night...
The Troublemakers say their goodbyes as they make their way back to Owen's truck.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks again, Mr. Horner!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Yep!
Erik hangs back with Delilah as the others go on ahead.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for everything, Mr. Horner. Especially for teaching me to stand my ground.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Don't mention it.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It was great having you over, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for having me.
An awkward stillness hangs in the air, as Mr. Horner remains looming over the two of them.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's just like Delilah said! He's watching to make sure I keep my distance from his daughter!
And then, suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Welp... Night, Delilah. Remember to lock up the turkey pen before you come back inside.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Y... Yes, Dad!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Erik? Suppose I'll see you around.
To their surprise, Mr. Horner turns and makes his way back into the house! The door closes, and the blinds on the front windows flip shut!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: 'See you around'? Does that mean he's gonna hunt me down?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: No, silly! It means he's okay with us seeing each other!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, he's saying we can go on actual dates?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Not only that, he gave us some `privacy...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not only that, he gave us some [color=#3b78e2][i]privacy...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And what does `that` mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: And what does [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] mean?

nodes.text: Delilah turns and grabs Erik by both cheeks...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It means I get to do `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It means I get to do [color=#3b78e2][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She pulls Erik in tightly for a long, sweet kiss!
When she finally releases him, Erik is blushing and grinning from ear to ear.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Wow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Wow.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: One more thing to be thankful for.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Delilah smiles coyly as she retreats back into the house.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Goodnight, Erik.
The front door closes, and Erik stands there for a moment, beaming.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Best. Thanksgiving. Ever.
You have reached the end of `Season 2, Episode 3: A Troublemakers Thanksgiving!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 2, Episode 3: A Troublemakers Thanksgiving![/b]

nodes.text: Have you checked out the Super New Girl yet? It's Surviving High School... With superpowers! What are you waiting for?!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If it wasn't for Ms. Lee's punishment, we never would have met through the community service program! Or gotten to work with Delilah for the Harvest Festival!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: You're thankful that you're all troublemakers? And that Delilah is now roped in with you all?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's... Not what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: They're making up for their trouble-making, Daddy! He's just glad for the good that came out of all the bad!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Hmph. I suppose.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nice save, Delilah!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not only because it brought us all this delicious food... But because without agriculture, the Horners wouldn't have been pumpkin farmers...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: And if we didn't provide pumpkins, we wouldn't have worked together during the festival...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Which is when Delilah and I first hit it off!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Which means this whole celebration might never have happened!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: In that case, I'm thankful for agriculture too!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yup! Makes perfect sense!
Delilah snorts as she chuckles along with Erik.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess weird minds think alike...
Later, everyone sits at the dinner table, admiring the stunning spread before them.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: This is amazing. Thank you all `so` much for helping out!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is amazing. Thank you all [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much for helping out!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Everything looks soooo yummy!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. Who needs turkey when Spencer is secretly a fancy cuisine prodigy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?! No I'm not!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know French delicacies when I see them. How do you explain that `coq au vin` you made?
nodes.text_bbcode: I know French delicacies when I see them. How do you explain that [color=#3b78e2][i]coq au vin[/i][/color] you made?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean my `Drunken Style Chicken Surprise?` I made that up while watching kung fu movies.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean my [color=#e23b3b][i]Drunken Style Chicken Surprise?[/i][/color] I made that up while watching kung fu movies.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And this `poulet cordon bleu?`
nodes.text_bbcode: And this [color=#3b78e2][i]poulet cordon bleu?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Bodyslam Bird with Cheese.` Perfect when watching wrestling.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Bodyslam Bird with Cheese.[/i][/color] Perfect when watching wrestling.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Spencer, you made a perfect `boeuf a la bourguinon!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer, you made a perfect [color=#3b78e2][i]boeuf a la bourguinon![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's just `Gridiron Beef-Splosion,` my gameday specialty!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's just [color=#e23b3b][i]Gridiron Beef-Splosion,[/i][/color] my gameday specialty!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I give up. I haven't eaten this well since I was rich. I'm just gonna sit back and enjoy it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Amen to that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm definitely thankful for all the food and friendship in the room right now, and for the Horners' hospitality...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Anyone? `'Thankful'?` That was a cue, people!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Anyone? [color=#3b78e2][i]'Thankful'?[/i][/color] That was a cue, people!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh... Are we really doing the 'what are we thankful for' thing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Yes.` So stop acting tough and let yourself be corny for a minute!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes.[/i][/color] So stop acting tough and let yourself be corny for a minute!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, if Paige is too stubborn, I'll start.
Owen and Paige both look up from their plates. Their eyes meet for just a moment...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm thankful that we can sit down and put our problems aside. Together. At least for a while.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Um... All of us, that is!
Paige hides the beginnings of a smile.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... Put me down for what he said.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I'm thankful for sports radio, good cooking oil, and for you guys. Every last one of ya.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And that's as sappy as I'm gonna get.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm thankful for our camaraderie, and for the relief it grants me from all my trivial worries...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...And also for `mashed potatoes.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And also for [color=#3b78e2][i]mashed potatoes.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What about you, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me? That's easy. I'm thankful for...
...He has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.
