nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Spencer picks up the ball and heads for the end zone...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just twenty yards to go...
...But each step is agony. Sharp, stabbing pains course through Spencer's leg.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Gotta... Ignore the pain!
Spencer crashes into the quarterback...
And hears a whistle!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! What does that whistle mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Roughing the passer...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It means game over...
In the meantime, Spencer writes in pain...
Spencer crashes into the quarterback...
And hears a whistle!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! What does that whistle mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Roughing the passer...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It means game over...
In the meantime, Spencer writes in pain...
Spencer knocks the ball loose!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The ball's out!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's good, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's great... But now he's got to pick up the ball!
Spencer crashes into the quarterback...
And hears a whistle!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! What does that whistle mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Roughing the passer...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It means game over...
In the meantime, Spencer writes in pain...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oops!
Spencer trips and falls awkwardly!
Spencer bares down on the opposing quarterback...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: When you snagged the Steelman Program spot away from me, you took away `something I want.`
nodes.text_bbcode: When you snagged the Steelman Program spot away from me, you took away [color=#e23b3b][i]something I want.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And if you don't give it back to me, I'm taking `something you want.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you don't give it back to me, I'm taking [color=#e23b3b][i]something you want.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $ALLISON isn't `something.` She's `someone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ALLISON isn't [color=#e23b3b][i]something.[/i][/color] She's [color=#e23b3b][i]someone![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Glad to see those grammar lessons she's giving you are paying off.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Must be pretty tough... Spending all that time so close to a cute girl like that and not making a move.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You stay away from her.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Gladly...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: As long as you don't play tonight.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Otherwise, I `have` been looking for a new girlfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Otherwise, I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] been looking for a new girlfriend.

nodes.text: Spencer curls his hands into fists.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Easy there, Tiger. You don't want to attack your own quarterback right before the big game.
Spencer slams Nate up against a locker.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't try to tell me what I want.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Fine! Hit me! See what happens!
A small crowd of players is starting to gather.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Better put him down, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're not worth it, Nate.
He lets go of Nate's jersey.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: See you around, Spencer... Say hi to $ALLISON for me.
Nate walks away.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow... He really got to you. What did he say?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It was just Nate making stupid threats as usual.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Take it from me... You can't make a deal with guys like that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Once you start, it just gets worse and worse.
Owen's phone beeps again, and he winces.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You gonna tell me who keeps texting you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Someone I made the wrong deal with a long time ago...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Promise you won't let Nate get to you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's a promise.
Two hours later, the game is in full-swing. Twin Branches is down 14-17 with only a few minutes left to play.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Coach... Just let me in. I can play on the offensive line, tailback, whatever!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You're still recovering. I'm not playing you unless I have to!
Nate jogs onto the field.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Time to go win us the game.
Nate heads out on the field and throws a long pass down toward the endzone...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Here comes the touchdown.
...But his pass gets picked off by the other team!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is all my fault!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How is it your fault?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: We need to get the ball back, stat!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Spencer, are you really sure you're fully healed?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes, sir!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You're a hundred percent certain you want to play?
For a moment, Spencer looks over to the sidelines, where the girls are cheering on the team.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't let our school be a loser!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Go, Owen! Get in there!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Then you get in there and get us that ball!
Spencer takes a step onto the field, and pain flares from his leg.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ignore the pain, Spencer... This is for Steelman! This is for the win!
Spencer lines up and stares at the opposing quarterback.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's go time.
The center hikes the ball to the quarterback!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've got to get past the offensive line!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I see I've got your attention. Good.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Now let me spell this out for you in language even you can understand.
Despite a sudden knot is his gut, Spencer doesn't blink.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who cares what's in your photo?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Apparently you're too stupid to recognize a threat when you see one.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So let me spell this out for you in language even you can understand.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I see I've got your attention. Good.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Now let me spell this out for you in language even you can understand.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I see I've got your attention. Good.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Now let me spell this out for you in language even you can understand.
You are now playing as Spencer.
It's Friday, and Spencer is psyching himself up for the last game of the season.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How's it going? Are you `actually` angry or just practicing your angry face?
nodes.text_bbcode: How's it going? Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] angry or just practicing your angry face?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just getting in my zone.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I see you're off crutches for the first time today... Leg feeling okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope. But that's not going to keep me out of the game.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get out of my zone, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure thing, buddy. Good luck!
Owen leaves, and Spencer slips on his headphones.
He starts listening to some music, pumping himself up...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You can do this, Spencer...
The music pulses through him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `You can do this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You can do this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Suddenly, someone pulls the headphones off of Spencer's ears!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hope I'm not interrupting.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You are, actually.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I just thought we should talk real quick...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm worried about you, Spencer. I don't want you to go out there and get yourself hurt.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: More like you don't want me to play so that I lose my spot in the Steelman Program!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I `do` happen to be the first guy on the waiting list...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] happen to be the first guy on the waiting list...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Honestly, though, lately I've been too preoccupied with my love life to worry about football.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't have time to sit around and talk about girls with you!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh, but I'm sure you'll want to talk about this particular girl...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My new friend, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A girl like $ALLISON wouldn't even give you the time of day, creep.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Then why do I have `this photo` on my phone?
nodes.text_bbcode: Then why do I have [color=#e23b3b][i]this photo[/i][/color] on my phone?

nodes.text: Nate takes out his phone... And shows a picture of himself and $ALLISON, cuddled close together!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh! I remember! They're going to the toy `charity warehouse` on Industrial. Building `C!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! I remember! They're going to the toy [color=#3b78e2][i]charity warehouse[/i][/color] on Industrial. Building [color=#3b78e2][i]C![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: ...And I think they're up to something very indecent!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Anyway, Owen, you don't have to do anything. Just wait in the car and be ready to drive in case something goes wrong.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: If we're not back in five minutes, we're in trouble, and we need your help. Come get us.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? You didn't say anything about leaving the car!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Well, I'm saying it now... Or, if you want we can drive back to Grandma's place.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, let's just get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: That's what I thought.
Sal, Dom, and Big Jon step out of the car, leaving Owen to sit while it idles...
Owen watches as they pick the lock to the chain slung through the handle of the big, glass door. A moment later, and they're in.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I could just leave them... I could just drive off and have nothing to do with this!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But then they'd come after me... Or Grandma...
Owen sits there nervously watching as the dashboard clock counts off the minutes that the guys have been inside.
`Two minutes. Three minutes. Four minutes...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Two minutes. Three minutes. Four minutes...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: They should be out already...
The `five` minute mark hits, and Owen shifts uncomfortably in the driver's seat.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [b]five[/b] minute mark hits, and Owen shifts uncomfortably in the driver's seat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where are they?!
`Six minutes. Seven minutes. Eight minutes...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Six minutes. Seven minutes. Eight minutes...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grr! Fine!
Owen reluctantly steps out of the idling car and heads for the warehouse door...
Inside the warehouse, Owen's eyes have trouble adjusting to the dark... He waits, noticing a laser alarm near the entrance...
He steps over it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Guys? Everything okay?
He walks farther in, heading toward what looks like a ransacked area near the back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sal? Dom? Big Jon?
When he gets there, he doesn't find anything except an old empty box. The place is empty!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What the--?
Suddenly, the front door flies open, and Sal, Dom, and Big Jon wheel several stacks of consoles out of the warehouse!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey!
Sal looks back at Owen, smiles, and kicks his foot out, triggering the alarm!
Owen runs for the door, but Sal steps out and closes it behind him, wedges a broom into the handle, and laughs at Owen from the behind the bars!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sal! Sal! Let me out! Don't do this!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Sorry, buddy, but you're the one getting caught this time!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I've been waiting `so` long for this moment! How's it feel to know that your life is ruined!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've been waiting [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] long for this moment! How's it feel to know that your life is ruined!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sal, don't do this, man! I never did anything to you!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: You left me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I had to... I had to get out.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Yeah, well, congratulations.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: And in case you're thinking about telling the cops, well...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Let's just say I could always go for seconds of Betty's famous spaghetti.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You won't get away with this!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I think I will. 'Cause you're stuck in there. And I'm out here.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I think what happens is the police come and while they won't know where those consoles went...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: They'll still hold `you` responsible.
nodes.text_bbcode: They'll still hold [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] responsible.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: They'll see that I'm stuck.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Yeah, go ahead and tell them what happened. You went on a heist and your thief friends betrayed you.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: See how much sympathy the cops have for you then...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Sucks to be you right now, doesn't it?
Sal smiles and waves goodbye. The guys stack the consoles into the trunk of Sal's car and drive off!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Stupid? Really? I'm about to make thousands of dollars in `one night.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Stupid? Really? I'm about to make thousands of dollars in [color=#e23b3b][i]one night.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Nothing stupid about that.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Yeah, that's not stupid. That's smart.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Cause money's a one-to-one measure of intelligence.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Heartless?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, we used to cause trouble when we were young...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But we'd `never` do something like this, man. The Sal I knew would `never` steal from kids!
nodes.text_bbcode: But we'd [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] do something like this, man. The Sal I knew would [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] steal from kids!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Wait... We're stealing from kids? I thought you said we were just stealing from a charity!

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Yeah, I `like` kids!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] kids!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Shut up! All of you! Don't listen to him... He's just trying to poison your mind.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: We `are` stealing from the charity. And they'll get new consoles, and everyone'll be happy, like I said.
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] stealing from the charity. And they'll get new consoles, and everyone'll be happy, like I said.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's bull.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: I don't know if I want to do this...

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Me either.
Sal glares at them, his eyes threatening.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Never mind. I'm still in.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Me too...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: When did I become so smart? Is that what you were going to ask?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Because that's what I'd ask someone who was about to make thousands of dollars in `one night.`

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh! I remember! They're going to a greenhouse near the sea... Something clarity! Clarity sea? No...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That doesn't sound right...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: No, it doesn't...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why don't we look at a map online? That might jog your memory...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Okay, but let's hurry!
A few minutes later, on Owen's computer...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: That's it! They're going to the toy `charity warehouse` on Industrial. Building `C!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it! They're going to the toy [color=#3b78e2][i]charity warehouse[/i][/color] on Industrial. Building [color=#3b78e2][i]C![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I wish I'd remembered that earlier...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Anyway, I think they're up to something very indecent!
Grandma Betty dishes out spaghetti to all the guys and then sits down next to Sal. Owen watches him like a hawk.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Mmmm! Just like I remember it!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: You're looking like you're in fine health, Betty.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, why thank you! What a thing to say! And I do drink my vegetable juice every morning, just like my doctor advises.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: So nothing's wrong? Nothing's happened to you... Yet?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, no, I've passed all my checkups! Still have a couple gallons of gas left in this old tank.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You snake.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I was just thinking... Now that I'm back, I'd really hate for something to happen to you.
He shoots a glare at Owen, hammering home the point.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We should get going.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Owie... Always trying to protect me... But who's protecting you?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: So soon?! But the food will go to waste!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Gotta go, Grandma.
The guys get up and head out the front door... Grandma Betty tries to pull Owen aside, but Sal intervenes...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: No time for goodbyes. Let's hit the road.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Owen...
You are now playing as Owen...
Outside, Dom and Big Jon climb into the back of Sal's slick, streamlined, black-cherry sports car. Owen can't help but whistle softly.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Tell me you're not impressed.
Sal hands Owen the keys and heads around the back of the car. He thumps his fist on the trunk, popping it open, and pulling out several black bags.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why'd you give me these keys?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Why do you think, genius? You're the driver.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't even know where we're going.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Like that matters... Get in.
Sal gets into the car, Owen hesitates, knowing what he's about to do is dangerous...
...But then he sees Grandma Betty looking worriedly out the window.
He gets into the car.
You are now playing as Paige.
A few moments later...
...Paige returns to Owen's house!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stupid Owen and his stupid face! Treat me like `I'm` not important! He's the one who's unimportant!
nodes.text_bbcode: Stupid Owen and his stupid face! Treat me like [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] not important! He's the one who's unimportant!

nodes.text: She grits her teeth as she marches up the walkway!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Acting all weird! What was that all about? Probably just avoiding the subject... Typical guy!
She reaches the front porch.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why should I let him get away with that?! So the timing's bad?! Is there ever a right time to discuss what's wrong with a relationship?!
Her face red, she bangs on the front door!
A moment later, it swings open!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We are having this conversation, and we are having it `n--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Paige, dear, I'm so glad you're here!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Owie's in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? What's wrong? Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Those hooligans took him to the, uh... the....
You are now playing as Grandma Betty.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Hold on now, give me a moment, sweetie. My memory's not what it used to be. They took him to...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I remember when I was your boys' age, I was the queen of the jitterbug!
She smiles at Sal warmly.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Now everyone simmer down and have some spaghetti!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: See?
Sal relaxes.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I'm so confused!
Sal reaches out and grabs Betty by the arm!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Don't play dumb with me, old lady!
Owen is up in a heartbeat!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let her go!
But Dom and Big Jon are quick to block him!
Sal lets go of Betty's arm.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Excuse my manners. Even if you did know what we were talking about, you wouldn't say anything, would you, Grandma?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Especially knowing that saying something could incriminate your precious grandson...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Why don't we forget about it and eat some spaghetti?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Best idea I've heard all day.
A car slowly drives by, and Owen tenses up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You should go now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Why?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, please... I can't tell you. It's for your own good.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We haven't even started to talk!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, and I swear, I want to talk too, but now is not the time...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: In fact, now is kind of the worst time...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's going on?! Why can't you tell me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just... Please. Go.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine! If you don't care about us, then you can just forget about having this conversation altogether!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's the opposite of what I want...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, your actions speak `way` louder than your words! I'll talk to you later!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, your actions speak [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] louder than your words! I'll talk to you later!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know what?! Forget that! I'm never talking to you again!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige...
But Paige storms off!
You are now playing as Owen.
Owen closes the door and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If they had come just then, that would have been a disaster...
When he looks up, he sees his grandmother standing in the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: What `is` going on, Owie? You've been acting skittish all day, and I've never seen you treat your girlfriend like that before...
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] going on, Owie? You've been acting skittish all day, and I've never seen you treat your girlfriend like that before...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You didn't even invite her in!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: One, she's not my girlfriend, and two, I'm not acting anything. Just... Please don't worry about me, Grandma.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I'll worry about you as much as I want to. That's my job!
The doorbell rings.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why is she still here?!
Owen angrily opens the door!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you to go, P--
But he stops when he sees who's standing on the porch...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: That's not very nice at all.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Little pig, little pig, let us in!

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Ha! Pigs!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, I'll... I'll be right out, guys.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Sal? Is that you? And Dominick? Oh, and little Jonathan?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: My my! Come in, all of you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, they'd come in, Grandma, but we have to--

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Hey! Let's not be rude! Besides, I didn't come all the way over here just to see your ugly mug.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Yeah, we didn't come for ugly mugs. We came for some of Betty's Famous Spaghetti!

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Heh. I love that stuff!
They all lumber into the house. As Sal passes, he gets right in Owen's face...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Wouldn't want to be rude to Grandma...
You are now playing as Grandma Betty.
A moment later, the four guys are all sitting at the dinner table while Grandma Betty deftly whips up some spaghetti.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I don't know what these monsters are doing here, but I've got to figure out where they're going with my Owie!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: So... Uh, boys, I haven't seen you around in ages!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I've been detained... Not a lot of free time when you take the fall for someone...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Or break the law.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Well, I'm always telling Owie that he should choose his friends carefully...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean he shouldn't have any at all!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Your grandma just basically called you a loser!

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Ha! Loser!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: She makes a point, `Owie.` You ditched us!
nodes.text_bbcode: She makes a point, [color=#e23b3b][i]Owie.[/i][/color] You ditched us!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I had to!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Anyway, what are you gentlemen doing here? Are you going to a dance together?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma...

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Yeah, we're going to the uh, `charity` dance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we're going to the uh, [color=#e23b3b][i]charity[/i][/color] dance.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Shut up.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: That seems important...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: How pleasant! And where's that?

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Heh. It's over at a club called the `Warehouse!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. It's over at a club called the [color=#e23b3b][i]Warehouse![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Shut up!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: In building `C!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In building [color=#e23b3b][i]C![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sal bangs his fist on the table!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: What part of shut up don't you understand?!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Sorry, Sal... It's not like she knows what we're talking about!
Sal looks up, inspecting Grandma Betty's face for recognition...

options.label: It sounds like a lovely dance.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...I actually had a `great` time!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...I actually had a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] time!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Glad you clarified that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. We went to a really fancy restaurant, and just talked for, like, hours!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lee is a total charmer! And his family owns a restaurant chain... Did you know that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You might have mentioned that a hundred times.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, sounds like a snob-tastic date. Maria and I had `fun` at the movies, by the way.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, sounds like a snob-tastic date. Maria and I had [color=#e23b3b][i]fun[/i][/color] at the movies, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, really? What movie did you see?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, uh, we didn't `see` much of the movie, if you know what I mean...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, uh, we didn't [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] much of the movie, if you know what I mean...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It doesn't matter. I still... We still need to talk!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...It was awful.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We ended up doing dishes at a restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, the perfect evening?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Haha! Rub it in more while you're at it! I'm sure you and Maria are the talk of the stupid town!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We went to the movies, and... Turns out, she's one of `those` people.
nodes.text_bbcode: We went to the movies, and... Turns out, she's one of [color=#e23b3b][i]those[/i][/color] people.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You mean... She wanted to talk during the whole movie?! Ha! You hate those people!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, what's the point of going to a movie if you're not going to pay attention to it?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, don't argue with me, I'm in your camp.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know...
Score Up!

nodes.title: Getaway
nodes.subtitle: Owen's past finally catches up to him. Can he escape?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
Paige gets off the bus in Owen's neighborhood...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is it!
...She walks to Owen's house and stomps up the walkway...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Time to give Owen a piece of my mind!
She knocks, rapping her knuckles hard against the front door.
A moment later, the door opens a crack, and Owen peeks out. Seeing Paige, he opens it all the way.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hi to you too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You shouldn't be here right now! It's not safe!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about, and I don't care! We need to talk!
Owen cranes his neck out, peering at the front yard and the street beyond.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm serious... You should go.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm serious too! I'm done with sneaking around and making out in broom closets. I need to know `what we are.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm serious too! I'm done with sneaking around and making out in broom closets. I need to know [color=#3b78e2][i]what we are.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen looks at her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I knew that'd get your attention!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, okay. We can talk, but... Just make it quick, okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever! I'll talk as long as I need to. And right now, I need to talk about Homecoming!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What about it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know that you only went with Maria because I went with Lee...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And yeah, I `said` that I had a really good time with him...
nodes.text_bbcode: And yeah, I [color=#3b78e2][i]said[/i][/color] that I had a really good time with him...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait, you didn't?
...She has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: ...Hesitates again!
She lets go of the shoe, sending it flying across the freeway and skittering along the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoops...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great! We're out of stuff to throw!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, can't we, um, do something else?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm out of ideas! How about you?!
Owen starts pulling the car over...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing?! We can still prove your innocent!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think so, Paige...
Owen pulls the car all the way off the freeway and turns off the engine.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's over...
As the police officer walks toward their car, Paige knows the trouble Owen's in, she knows that...

At the last second, Paige hesitates!
Unfortunately, the momentum of her arm causes her to let go of the shoe, which ricochets harmless off the hood of Owen's grandmother's car.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wrong car!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, Commander Obvious!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did I not tell you?! These shoes are my favorite! I'm a little attached!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, you've only got one left now!
Paige sticks her head out the window again, holding the second heel...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Paige... Concentrate...
She pulls her arm back and...

nodes.text: It's over...
As the police officer walks toward their car, Paige knows the trouble Owen's in, she knows that...
At the last second, Paige hesitates!
Unfortunately, the momentum of her arm causes her to let go of the shoe, which ricochets harmless off the hood of Owen's grandmother's car.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wrong car!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, Commander Obvious!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did I not tell you?! These shoes are my favorite! I'm a little attached!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, you've only got one left now!
Paige sticks her head out the window again, holding the second heel...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Paige... Concentrate...
She pulls her arm back and...
Owen tries to pull off his daring move, but instead botches it, the car coming to a slow halt just inches from one of the cop cars...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not how I planned that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nice move... I think I could have done `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice move... I think I could have done [color=#3b78e2][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks...
Owen spins the wheel, pulls the emergency brake, and drifts through the blockade, the car spinning perfectly through the arrangement of cop cars as if guided by an unseen hand.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Woohoo!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How?! What?!
Owen spins the wheel back, drops the brake, and floors the gas, accelerating ahead, out the other side, and onto the freeway!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where did you learn this?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We can talk about that later! Right now, we've gotta catch up to the guys!
Owen weaves carefully and methodically through traffic, keeping the black-cherry car in sight.
A police siren wails behind him!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I really don't like when you say that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought that the guys would have the consoles in the back of the car!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah? So?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look! I don't see them!
Up ahead, except for Big Jon, the back of the black-cherry car seems empty.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They're probably in the trunk, unless they--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Haha! The trunk! That's perfect!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? 'Cause we might have different definitions of perfect!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sal popped it open earlier! If we can hit it with something, it'll pop and the cops'll see the stolen consoles...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, `so` easy! We'll just hit their trunk with an object on the `freeway` in the middle of a `high speed chase!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] easy! We'll just hit their trunk with an object on the [color=#3b78e2][i]freeway[/i][/color] in the middle of a [color=#3b78e2][i]high speed chase![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not we... `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not we... [color=#e23b3b][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, no more football for you. You've officially suffered head trauma.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't do it! I'm driving!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're serious about this?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's our only chance!
Owen accelerates toward the black-cherry car, pulling up right behind it...
You are now playing as Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What am I supposed to throw?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know! Find something!
Paige looks behind her into the backseat of the car...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This car is spotless! There's nothing in it! There's nothing to throw!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, why don't you throw... Um... Why don't you throw your shoes?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you have a better idea?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah! How about I throw you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Seriously, you have to do it, Paige! I'm not going to be able to tail them for much longer!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Urrg! I can't believe I'm gonna do this!
Paige reaches down and unstraps her heels!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: These are high-end heels that I got on-sale! They're like my `best` pair of shoes!
nodes.text_bbcode: These are high-end heels that I got on-sale! They're like my [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] pair of shoes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Now,` Paige!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Now,[/i][/color] Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Just keep your eyes on the road.
She rolls down her window, sticks her head out, cocks her arm back, brings it forward, and...
A few winding turns later, and...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's the freeway!
A black-cherry car takes the ramp ahead of them!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And there are the guys!
Suddenly, several cop cars arrange themselves ahead, forming a blockade! Owen accelerates toward it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing?! There's no speeding through this one!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hold onto something!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't like that you said that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's been a while since I pulled this move...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just have to `spin the wheel, pull the emergency brake, and drift...` I just hope Grandma's car can take it!
nodes.text_bbcode: I just have to [color=#e23b3b][i]spin the wheel, pull the emergency brake, and drift...[/i][/color] I just hope Grandma's car can take it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Move?! What move?! Why are you pulling a move?!
They reach the cop cars!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here goes nothing!
Panicking, Owen twists the wheel right, then left, before running right over the metallic row of spikes!
Owen slams on the brakes, and the car comes screeching to a stop just a few feet shy of the strip!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Close one!
He throws it into reverse, spins into a turn, and heads down a side street!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who are you?! And what have you done with Owen?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm just getting warmed up...
Owen panics, doing nothing as the car runs right over the metallic row of spikes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're not gonna make it!
Owen slams on the brakes, the car coming to a halt right in front of the police cruisers.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess that was short-lived...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Better to be safe than sorry, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess...
A moment later, a cop is rapping his knuckles against the window. Owen rolls it down...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Officer...
He can only barely begin to comprehend just how much trouble he's in, but he knows vaguely that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We've gotta get to the freeway! That's where the guys are heading!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then turn right here!
Owen turns right, the tires squealing!
A second later, one of the police cars careens onto the street behind him!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh...
The squad car catches up, blaring over the intercom...

nodes.speaker: Police
nodes.text: This is the police. Pull over. We know you've stolen the consoles.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Left here!
Owen veers left, the cop right on his tail!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's that ahead?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh again...
Up ahead, a police officer throws down a long metallic strip!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's a spike strip!
The gap between the two police cars is about a car-width wide!
Paige closes her eyes and...
The car screeches through the blockade, sparks flying off both sides!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoo! We made it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We did?! We're alive?! Ohmygosh! We're alive!
Owen keeps his foot down!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! Come on!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're not going to make it! We're not going to make it!
Owen presses hard on the gas pedal!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here we go!
The gap narrows!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen tries the door, but it doesn't give! He bangs on it, trying to force it open with his shoulder...
...But it still doesn't budge.
In the distance, Owen hears the wailing of police sirens.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's it then... This is how it ends.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The police are going to get here, and then I'm going to be arrested, and then my life is basically over.
He hangs his head, pressing it to the glass...
...When he hears a familiar voice from outside.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige?! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Saving you, duh! P.S. You're welcome!
She removes the broom handle from the door and pulls it open!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Listen, the cops are going to show up any second! We can't be here when they are, or I'll be taken away!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This way!
Paige leads Owen toward Grandma Betty's car, a faded green 1970's rusted relic with a thin coat of dust on it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What did you do to get into this mess?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's complicated! If I didn't help them, they were going to hurt my grandma!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great friends you used to have!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is this honestly the time for judging?! Give me the keys!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who says `you` get to drive?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Who says [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] get to drive?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? We're going to have this argument now? Just trust me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Urrg! Fine!
Paige reluctantly flips Owen the keys, and they get in!
The sirens grow louder...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The only way I'm ever getting out of this is if I can prove that I didn't steal anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ahem... Did you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No!
The sirens are deafening, almost upon them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's too late! We're not gonna outrun the cops!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's exactly what we're gonna do.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There's something I've never told you about me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You'll see! Just buckle up and hold onto something!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've seen you drive before, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, you really haven't.
Owen floors the gas, and the car shoots forward!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhhhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Up ahead is a T-intersection. Two police cars turn onto the street!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you gonna do?
Seeing Owen's car, they turn, tires screeching, trying to form a blockade!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, what are you gonna do?!
Owen eyes the closing gap between the cars!
With one last solid push, Spencer forces the plywood roof free from the walls around them, like the lid of a box!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You did it!
The three climb out of the cottage and find themselves in the now quiet, desserted mall!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's closed... Everyone's gone!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But where's my sister?
At this, Amanda walks over casually from nearby.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey guys!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Amanda? You got stuck here after closing too?
Spencer strains with all his might! The plywood roof groans and bends... But does not budge!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guess this building's not as poorly-constructed as I thought.
Just when the three of them are ready to give up... A knock sounds at the door! It swings open, revealing...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey guys! I saw Mrs. Claus's Gingerbread Cottage start to move and shake, so I thought I'd knock and see if Mrs. Claus was all right!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We're saved!
The three of them join Amanda out in the now quiet, deserted mall.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The mall's closed! Amanda, how'd you get stuck here too?
The three of them duck through the small door of the miniature cottage. Inside, the house is brightly colored and decorated with toys!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Wow! Everything's so colorful and... Whimsical! I've never seen anything like it!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm glad.
Spencer and Allison lock eyes, exchanging smiles... And then notice that Kimi is also in the room.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh! Well, you two look like you have everything under control here, so... I think I hear Amanda calling! Byeee!
Kimi turns for the cottage's exit, when the thin wooden door swings shut with a `click.` She reaches for it when suddenly she realizes...
nodes.text_bbcode: Kimi turns for the cottage's exit, when the thin wooden door swings shut with a [b]click.[/b] She reaches for it when suddenly she realizes...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um, guys? The doorknob on this side is fake... I'm pretty sure it's just glued on!
Spencer and $ALLISON rush over, pushing at the front door, turning the decorative knob... But the wood doesn't move!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We're trapped!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess this was never meant to be a fully functioning house... Or a fully functioning door.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no! Well, um... Pretend I'm not here, you two! Just... Go on about your private business!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Spencer and I had no 'business' here. We were just looking at these decorations.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Um, yeah... What she said.
Suddenly, a calm voice sounds over the mall intercom.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The mall... It's closing!
The three of them bang and shout from inside the cottage, but no one hears them. Soon, they sit on the floor, resigned.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's no use. We're at the mercy of our shoddy, poorly-constructed prison.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait a minute... 'Poorly constructed'? That gives me an idea!
Spencer stands in the middle of the miniature cottage and lifts his hands to the ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't take the door off its hinges, but I might be able to lift this roof right off of the walls!
Spencer gathers his strength, and he...
Spencer scans his surroundings for security guards. When the coast is clear, he hops over the velvet rope barrier separating the display.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on, $ALLISON. Come with me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But... Won't we get in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We're just taking a quick look. We'll be back in a second!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I dunno...
Kimi sighs and hops over the barrier, showing $ALLISON it's safe.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You'll be fine! See?
Spencer takes $ALLISON's hand and helps her over the barrier.
They make their way to the clock tower, the tallest in a row of small, whimsical buildings.
Inside a tiny door, they find a small wooden stair case leading to the top of the tower. As they climb, Spencer looks back at $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pretty cool, huh?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah! Everything is so cute and whimsical! But I'm most surprised by this faux building's structural integrity!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A top-heavy construction of thin plywood, plastic, and paper mache shouldn't be able to bear the weight of two people climbing up to the highest--
`CRACK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]CRACK![/b]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh oh.
The wood cracks beneath them as one side of the flimsy tower buckles under their weight! With a groan and a sway, the whole clock tower goes toppling over!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Aah!
The Candy Cane Clock Tower crashes into its next door neighbor, starting a domino effect that knocks down Peppermint Post Office!
...And then the `Spiced Cider City Hall!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And then the [b]Spiced Cider City Hall![/b]

nodes.text: ...And the `Cookie Crumb Courthouse!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And the [b]Cookie Crumb Courthouse![/b]

nodes.text: ...And even the `Muffin Municipal Center!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And even the [b]Muffin Municipal Center![/b]

nodes.text: When Spencer and Allison finally dig their way out of the scraps, the entirety of Santa's Village is a flattened pile of rubble!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... My bad...
All around them, shocked shoppers and mortified children gasp and wail! $ALLISON shrinks away in embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `...Not` your finest moment, Spencer.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...Not[/i][/color] your finest moment, Spencer.

nodes.text: Spencer's face burns with shame, and as he pulls Allison out of the clutter, deep inside he knows...
...He has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: $ALLISON sweeps her hair behind her ear, hiding her smile and the pink color flushing to her cheeks...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... Wasn't talking about the `drink.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I... Wasn't talking about the [color=#3b78e2][i]drink.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh! Heh...
Spencer takes a drink, stalling while he thinks of something to say...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... Your sister gets pretty excited about this holiday stuff, huh?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah, for as long as I can remember.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And how bout you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've never really taken part in the holiday season... I guess it's because I've always viewed myself as the logical, mature one in the family. How could I let myself buy into all these silly traditions?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Because they're fun! Are you saying you've never hung stockings on the fireplace? Or stayed up on Christmas Eve to try and catch Santa Claus?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...Wait, you stayed up trying to catch Santa Claus?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was six. It was an important experiment.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And more importantly, you've got a ton of traditions to catch up on! Snowball fights, tree decorating, stories by the fireplace...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That sounds like it could be a lot of fun, with the right people...
Suddenly, Amanda comes running back, with Kimi in tow.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $ALLISON! Quick! Do you have any salt?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Huh? Why?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Reindeer are attracted to sodium and nutrient-rich salt licks.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't think reindeer would... 'Graze' so close to a heavily populated shopping mall.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're probably right.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But we could go down Sugar Plum Street and see all the elf houses!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You mean the child-size playhouses made of plastic and paper mache?
Amanda grabs $ALLISON by the arm excitedly and pulls her off toward the display of fake gingerbread houses.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry, Spencer... I tried to keep Amanda away for as long as I could, but she's hard to keep up with. Any magical romance happen?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Nah, nothing 'magical' really...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Shoot... Well, there's still a chance! You just gotta get her somewhere quiet and secluded!
Kimi leads Spencer, pulling him toward Sugar Plum Street after $ALLISON and Amanda. When they meet up, Kimi pulls Amanda aside once more.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda... Do you know anything about polar bears?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sure! They're the largest carnivorous mammals on land!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm not sure these decorative statues of polar bears are scientifically accurate.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, they all have scarves and ice skates, so... No.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And they also don't `blink` like real polar bears! Amanda, have you ever noticed them blinking?
nodes.text_bbcode: And they also don't [color=#3b78e2][i]blink[/i][/color] like real polar bears! Amanda, have you ever noticed them blinking?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No! But I could watch them to make sure!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's a great idea!
Kimi nudges Spencer with her elbow as Amanda leaves to inspect the bears.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You should take $ALLISON to get a closer look at one of these buildings. And quick, before Amanda gets back!
Spencer looks to the display and spots two buildings with open doors. A tall, rickety clock tower overlooking the whole village, and a small but elaborately decorated pink cottage...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hmm... I guess I'll take her to see...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Yes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I mean... Yes, that sounds lovely. Peppermint and chocolate is my favorite flavor combination.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, I remember you mentioning it. C'mon!
$ALLISON grips Spencer's arm with excitement as he leads her down to the mall cafe.
Soon, the two of them are huddled together on a bench sipping from two steaming cups of hot chocolate flavored with a dash of peppermint.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Mmm... Thank you, Spencer! This was so sweet!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know, right? Flavored just right!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, okay.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: C'mon!
Spencer leads $ALLISON to the mall cafe. Soon, the two of them are sipping on chocolate milkshakes.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good, huh?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh! Sure... It's just, chocolate drinks are sold year round. I usually look forward to seasonal flavor combinations, like peppermint chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Aw, that's right! I remember you saying that! Guess I dropped the ball on this one.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's fine. This chocolate shake is perfectly adequate.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait a second! I've got an idea! Don't move!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hmm?
Spencer runs off... And comes back with a candy cane!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Here. Watch this.
Spencer takes $ALLISON's shake and stirs it with the peppermint candy cane! $ALLISON smiles and takes a sip.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Wow! Thank you, Spencer. This is was so sweet!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Glad to hear it tasted all right!
Spencer draws a blank!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... I dunno, maybe we could get milkshakes?

nodes.title: It Takes A Village
nodes.subtitle: Will Spencer and $ALLISON ever have a magic moment alone?

nodes.text: The next day, back at the mall...
You are now playing as Spencer.
Spencer and Kimi walk through the plaza of the mall, a torrent of shoppers swarming around them.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Now, just remember the plan. You chat it up with $ALLISON, and leave her sister to me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Once we get to Santa's Village, I'll distract Amanda and lead her away!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay. Then what?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then the two of you have a magical moment! There's loads of romantic stuff in Santa's Village!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Share some wintery treats! Take her to one of the elves' houses! Kiss her under some mistletoe!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, all right! I get the idea!
The two make their way to 'Santa's Village', a section of the mall decorated with lights, holly, and an entire snow-covered scene of elf-sized houses.
They find $ALLISON and her sister perusing a section of Gum Drop Lane.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Allison! Hey, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Spencer! Kimi! Isn't this great? It's like a winter wonderland! Little elves in their gingerbread houses! A musical band of toy soldiers and snowmen!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's nonsensical. Why would an elf live in a gingerbread structure? Gingerbread would certainly freeze at these proposed temperatures.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Not `magic` gingerbread!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#3b78e2][i]magic[/i][/color] gingerbread!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And why is a snowman the violinist in the Christmas 'band'? He lacks the articulated elbows to operate a violin!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Magic elbows!
As the conversation heats up, Kimi steps in between the Applebee sisters.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So this conversation is super interesting, but I think I heard something! `'Up on the rooftop, reindeer paws!'` just like in the song!
nodes.text_bbcode: So this conversation is super interesting, but I think I heard something! [color=#3b78e2][i]'Up on the rooftop, reindeer paws!'[/i][/color] just like in the song!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Amanda, want to come investigate with me?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But reindeer are even-toed ungulates.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ungu-wuh?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It means they have hooves, not paws. My sister's actually something of a prodigy when it comes to animal facts.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Right! Ungulates. Anyway, Amanda, wanna go look for some?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We'll be riiight back, you two!
Kimi sneaks a sly wink to Spencer as she and Amanda wander off, deeper into the mall.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well... Guess it's just us.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So... What exactly does one do at Santa's Village?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh! We could...
A gaggle of sharply-dressed girls eye Delilah. Though the music drowns out their laughter, it's plain to see they are snickering...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Erik, I think I want to go. This really isn't my kind of place.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What are you talking about? It's everyone's kind of place!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well then, `you` can stay as long as you want. I'm leaving!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well then, [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] can stay as long as you want. I'm leaving!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait!
Erik turns, but Delilah has already bolted for the exit! He runs after her!
Outside, Erik finds Delilah siting on the curb.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Delilah?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Erik. I just couldn't be in there any longer.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But, this is what people do on first dates! Everyone else--

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I don't care what everyone else does!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I thought you were `different` from everyone else, Erik! That's why I like you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought you were [color=#3b78e2][i]different[/i][/color] from everyone else, Erik! That's why I like you!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: But maybe I was wrong.
Erik takes a seat next to her.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I... I just wanted to impress you. I wanted to make sure our first date swept you off your feet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I was afraid my original idea wasn't good enough. I like you a lot, Delilah. I didn't want to mess this up.
Delilah tries to hide the beginnings of a smile... But fails.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I like you too, Erik. But I like you most when you're being `yourself!` You don't have to take me to some trendy spot to impress me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I like you too, Erik. But I like you most when you're being [color=#3b78e2][i]yourself![/i][/color] You don't have to take me to some trendy spot to impress me!

nodes.text: Delilah places her hand on Erik's.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: ...You've already done that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: So... What `was` your original idea?
nodes.text_bbcode: So... What [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] your original idea?

nodes.text: Later, at `Colonial Simmonsburg...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Later, at [b]Colonial Simmonsburg...[/b]

nodes.text: Erik and Delilah laugh as they frolic through the thoroughfare of an old fashioned town. Lights and holly hang from every tree and lamp post.
At the general shoppe, they try on traditional garb from the 1700's.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What do you think of this Sunday bonnet, good sir? Does it make me appear comely?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why no, m'lady! It makes you look perfectly chaste and sensible!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Perfect! Hee hee!
Later, the two of them sit in the back of a horse-drawn buggy, each munching on a drumstick of roast goose!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: So this is what Paul Revere ate in his day? It's delicious!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can taste the history!
And as the evening draws to a close, fife and fiddle music fills the air as everyone gathers in Town Hall for a social!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: May I have this dance?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Of course!
Erik gives a bow, and Delilah answers with a curtsy. The two link elbows and spin in circles on the dance floor until their sides hurt from laughter.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I can't remember the last time I had this much fun!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me neither! I'm glad you liked Colonial Simmonsburg. I was afraid you might think all this stuff was weird.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Are you kidding? This is the best date I've ever had!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fortunately, unlike the American Revolution... The date's `not over yet.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fortunately, unlike the American Revolution... The date's [color=#e23b3b][i]not over yet.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik turns to Delilah and pulls her close...
...Their lips meet, just as the first fireworks burst in the sky above them, illuminating Simmonsburg with a warm, flickering glow!
Erik jumps and fist-pumps in rhythm with the crowd!
Soon, Delilah finds herself the odd person out, the only one dancing differently amidst a sea of uniform club-goers! She stops in her tracks, her face growing flushed.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Erik! Why didn't you tell me I looked so silly!
Erik sidles up next to Delilah and matches her dance, step for step!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: This is ridiculous! This doesn't go with the music at all!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, but it's fun!
The two continue their dance, until Delilah notices the stares of the crowd.
Erik freezes, staring motionlessly!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I can't help but feel... Out of place here, Erik. Maybe we should just ask for the check.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... Should I get some doggy bags too?
Delilah's face flushes the slightest shade of red...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I think I'll pass.
Later, Erik and Delilah step into a club pulsing with lights and thumping bass.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, this place looks fun right?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Looks a little crowded... I didn't think this kind of place was your style.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But Kimi says that anyone who's anyone goes to this club!
The two of them push through the crowd and onto the dance floor, the thundering club anthem assailing them from all sides.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I'm not sure how to dance to this. It sounds like broken robot music.
The crowd bounces along with the beat, pumping their fists in the air.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just do what ever you feel like!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Heh... Well, all right!
Delilah shimmies into a silly little two-step! The crowd slowly backs away from her...
Erik steps into the clearing and...
The waiter gasps, taken aback.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Surely a five star chef can accomodate a special request for the lady!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee hee... Thanks, Erik.
Though flustered, the waiter leaves with their order, and soon returns with two servings of fried chicken.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Just like mom used to make!
The two dig in, but soon, the diners around them slide quizzical glances in their direction...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I... Get the feeling we're being watched.
The waiter nods, satisfied, as he leaves for the kitchen. Soon, he returns with two servings of foie gras.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ah, yes...
Delilah eyes the dish curiously.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Erik, what exactly is foie gras?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know, I'm not really sure! Let me look it up...
Erik pulls out his phone and types 'foie gras' into a search engine...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It says here we're eating goose...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...Liver.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh. That's... Festive. What'd they do with the `rest` of the goose?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh. That's... Festive. What'd they do with the [color=#3b78e2][i]rest[/i][/color] of the goose?

nodes.text: Delilah squeamishly pokes at the strange dish with a fork, examining it like an alien life form...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But this is where everyone at school goes to hang out!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I know, I just... Feel a little out of place here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... All right...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe we can skip to dinner. Are you hungry?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Starving!
Later, Erik sits across a candlelit table from Delilah at `Chez Frou Frou.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Later, Erik sits across a candlelit table from Delilah at [b]Chez Frou Frou.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Wow... This is really fancy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, crazy, right?
Delilah eyes the menu, her brow furrowed...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Why don't you order for us, Erik? I can't even pronounce half the fancy French dishes on this menu...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Guess I've always preferred simple, down-home kinda stuff. Comfort food, you know?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Totally. Not sure they've got anything like that here, though...
The waiter approaches and asks for their order...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We will both have...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Only the finest, fanciest clothes!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: But... I `like` the clothes I've got. They're functional... And comfortable!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] the clothes I've got. They're functional... And comfortable!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh! That's not... What I mean is... Your clothes are great!
Delilah's eyes drift to a lavish store window where a tall, slender mannequin displays a provocative dress and towering high heels.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Not compared to `this` stuff. I think I've had enough of the mall, Erik.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not compared to [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] stuff. I think I've had enough of the mall, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know, just to try something different!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, I'll admit... It is kinda funny to see what all these fancy people wear.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Look at those ridiculous high heels! What are those for? Aerating topsoil?
Delilah and Erik chuckle childishly outside a boutique window.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Heheheh...
Just then, a clerk notices them laughing from the other side of the glass.
She scans Delilah, eyeing her outfit before turning up her nose with an arrogant scoff and walking away. Erik notices Delilah's smile sink away.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I, uh... I think I've had enough of the mall, Erik.

nodes.title: Erik's Holi-Date
nodes.subtitle: Can Erik make his first date with Delilah one to to remember?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Erik.
Later that day, Erik leads Delilah through the plaza of a crowded, bustling shopping mall.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Thanks for taking me out, Erik. I can't wait for our date.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well wait no more, m'lady! Our date has begun!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Here? At the mall? I assumed you needed to run an errand or something.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nope! I wanted to take you shopping at the fanciest boutiques in town! Kimi says they're all here at this mall!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Boutiques? Is something wrong with the clothes I have on?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No! It's just that...

options.label: I thought it might be fun!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, slow down there!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean... Do you really think that'll work?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Trust me! All you have to do is follow my lead!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well... All right.
Spencer and Kimi return to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now I remember! I'm going to the mall... Also.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Crazy coincidence, right? We should all meet up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sounds good! I definitely welcome the company.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah.... Ditto.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Man, I'm good!
As Spencer and $ALLISON chat amongst themselves, Kimi notices Erik fussing over his hair, peering at his round, distorted reflection in the shiny doorknob at the back of the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What are you doing, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hmm? Oh, just making sure I look my best for my date with Delilah tonight!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You mean your `first` date with Delilah? Oooh, I'm so excited! Where are you going to take her?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean your [color=#3b78e2][i]first[/i][/color] date with Delilah? Oooh, I'm so excited! Where are you going to take her?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've got it all planned out! It's the holiday season, so I'll be taking her to Colonial Simmonsburg!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That place where everyone dresses like pilgrims and George Washingtons?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes! It's my favorite place in the world! It's a community that does historical reenactments of colonial living!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's just like being alive in Paul Revere's day!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And also like being lame in present day. No offense Erik, but that's a horrible idea for a first date!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes! You need to impress Delilah! You've got to take her to the trendiest places, the fanciest restaurant, the hottest club!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Those things aren't really my style...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But you want Delilah to be `wowed,` don't you?
nodes.text_bbcode: But you want Delilah to be [color=#3b78e2][i]wowed,[/i][/color] don't you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then trust me. If you take my suggestions, this will be a night Delilah will never forget!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We hang out all the time for community service. It's mandatory. Remember? You were `there.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We hang out all the time for community service. It's mandatory. Remember? You were [color=#e23b3b][i]there.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The only difference this time is that her sister would be there. And maybe a fake Santa.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Right... But if I could distract Amanda and lead her away, you and $ALLISON would be alone together...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...And free to have a magical romantic moment under the mistletoe!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's a hangout that seems casual and friendly... But once we're at the mall, I'll distract Amanda and `voila!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a hangout that seems casual and friendly... But once we're at the mall, I'll distract Amanda and [color=#3b78e2][i]voila![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You and $ALLISON are all alone together and free to have a magical romantic moment under the mistletoe!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, me and Owen are working stuff out. When there's something to tell, `maybe` I'll let you know.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, me and Owen are working stuff out. When there's something to tell, [color=#3b78e2][i]maybe[/i][/color] I'll let you know.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've got enough to worry about trying to shop for a gift.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You guys are exchanging gifts? That's big!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, yeah! A gift is the fastest way to sum up a relationship... Or lack of relationship!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah, of course! I knew that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If you want things to patch things up with Owen, your best bet is to make this gift `perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: If you want things to patch things up with Owen, your best bet is to make this gift [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean, if that `is` what you want. No pressure, though.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, if that [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] what you want. No pressure, though.

nodes.text: Paige glances over at Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure. No pressure...
Kimi turns her head as she overhears Spencer chatting with Allison.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $ALLISON, what do you have planned for the break?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: My sister Amanda wants to visit 'Santa's Village' at the local shopping mall tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've never gone before. I told her that it was a poor appropriation of germanic folklore for the commercialization of a holiday.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...But then she promised me peppermint hot chocolate, so I begrudgingly agreed.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh, I don't blame you. That peppermint hot chocolate's a game-changer.
Kimi notices the warm smile on Spencer's face as Allison giggles...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What a coincidence, $ALLISON! Spencer and I will be at the mall tomorrow too!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We will?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes! You said you would come Christmas shopping with me... `Remember?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! You said you would come Christmas shopping with me... [color=#3b78e2][i]Remember?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then maybe I need to remind you.
Kimi stands and pulls Spencer up from his seat, taking him aside.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What the heck are you talking about, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You want to spend more time with $ALLISON, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? I mean... I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh come on! I know how you feel about her!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: This is the perfect opportunity for you to...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't get 'crazy'!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. Then you don't mind if we end the conversation right here.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um... Totally! Fine by me...
Kimi nods, drumming her fingers on the table impatiently, filling the tense silence. Anxiety bubbles up inside of her, until...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I can't take it anymore! Tell me what happened! Please please `please!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't take it anymore! Tell me what happened! Please please [color=#3b78e2][i]please![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See what I mean? Crazy.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But... I just want to help!
Paige sighs, resigning.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But trust me, I just want to help!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine... I guess you always have good intentions or whatever.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Does that mean you'll let me in on what's really going on?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: So stuff yourself with cookies! That's an order!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that really the only reason you're letting us off the hook today?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
