nodes.text: The truth is, not everyone thought this Troublemakers program was going to be successful.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But after this semester, I'd say you proved them wrong.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Despite all expectations, you're actually a fine group of kids to work with.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awwwww, Ms. Lee!
Just then, the phone on the desk rings, and Ms. Lee responds with curt answers.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Excuse me, kids, I'm needed in the office. But those cookies better be gone by the time I get back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't have to tell `me` twice!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't have to tell [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] twice!

nodes.text: Ms. Lee leaves the room as the Troublemakers help themselves to the cookies.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Aren't you guys excited? Once we get out of this, we're free for two weeks of winter fun!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I won't lie. A break sounds really good.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Definitely. Some relaxation. Some gifts. Can't complain.
Kimi notices a warm, fleeting glance between Owen and Paige. She leans over and whispers to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You two are surprisingly not-fighty today.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What happened? You guys finally make up?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! Gimme a break, Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Fine. But if something did happen, you'd tell me, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `...Right?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...Right?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Kimi, I'm telling you this because we're friends... But you kinda get crazy when it comes to relationship gossip.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who, me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: There's gotta be a catch. There's no way Ms. Lee is doing something this nice!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: If you want to clean up graffiti under the overpass, I can arrange for that, Ms. Chen.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But Dr. Bill said on his talk show yesterday that we should practice compassion and moderation for healthy living.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I knew there was a softer side of Ms. Lee!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Thank you for saying so, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Some members of my book club said I couldn't do it. Said I was too hardened and erratic to show compassion.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But I'll show `them!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I'll show [color=#3b78e2][i]them![/i][/color]

nodes.title: Christmas Stories
nodes.subtitle: What are the Troublemakers up to during Winter Break?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Kimi.
The Troublemakers gather for their last detention session before the Winter Break.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All right, Troublemakers. I only have you for one more day before I cut you loose for two whole weeks, so we're gonna do something special...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no... Here it comes...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're gonna have to do some crazy impossible task, aren't we?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, like shovel snow out of every driveway in Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or knit sweaters for the homeless out of recycled cardboard...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Or accelerate matter beyond the speed of light...
The group silently turns to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...Which is `also impossible,` guys.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Which is [color=#3b78e2][i]also impossible,[/i][/color] guys.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No, it's nothing like that.
Ms. Lee flips on a radio and opens a box on her desk...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: ...The six of you are to enjoy these festive cookies and listen to holiday carols for the remainder of your hour in detention.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wuh?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This... Can't be for real!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Guys, I think Ms. Lee is being...
Later that afternoon, Paige waits for Owen out in the parking lot.
Before long, he comes running, holding something behind his back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry, Paige, I had to find something that--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: --Whoa.
Owen's eyes fall to Paige's outfit.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's wrong? Sad to see the old Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I stand by my original statement of 'whoa'. You look good.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks. I just... Felt like a change.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway... I got you this.
Paige presents a box to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Um... I think our department store carries those, but are you sure that's what you need?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, can you get it for me or not?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sure! I'll have one brought out!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sure! I'll have one brought out!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What's the make and model of the vehicle?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Those are things I have to know?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh boy. This may take a while.
The clerk happily goes through Paige's offerings, sorting and tallying as she goes...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: So, after reviewing your clothes, this is the total I can offer you...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That... Isn't very much.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Unfortunately, these are all pieces from past seasons. The demand just isn't that high for them anymore.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Isn't there anything you can do? You know... For the sake of 'young love', or whatever?
The clerk looks Paige up and down, thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Well, I usually don't give tips like this, but... That dark, rebel look you have on is really `in` right now.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I usually don't give tips like this, but... That dark, rebel look you have on is really [color=#3b78e2][i]in[/i][/color] right now.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: That top is a Giorgetti classic. And that leather skirt is vintage DiMaggio! They'll fetch a better price than all of this stuff combined!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: No lie. So, if this boy is worth `literally` selling the clothes off your back...
nodes.text_bbcode: No lie. So, if this boy is worth [color=#3b78e2][i]literally[/i][/color] selling the clothes off your back...

nodes.text: Minutes later, Paige steps out of the dressing room, wearing one of the old outfits from her backpack. She stops in front of a mirror...

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: `Sniff`... It's so... `Sniff`... Beautiful!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sniff[/i][/color]... It's so... [color=#3b78e2][i]Sniff[/i][/color]... Beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What, this outfit? That's not what you said a minute ago when you offered me pocket change for it!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Not the outfit! Your sacrifice! ...Oh, `young love!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not the outfit! Your sacrifice! ...Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]young love![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey... Let's not get too trigger-happy with the 'L' word...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But thanks for your help. Honestly.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now, if you'll excuse me... I've got more shopping to do.
Later, Paige finds herself in the autoshop of the mall's department store. A clerk slides out from underneath a car being serviced.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey there, miss... Are you... Lost?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Just that, you don't look like the gearhead type...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, I had a very tough-looking leather skirt, but I sold it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sure... What can I do for you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I need a part for a broken truck.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Okay... What kinda part?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I need a...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: These clothes were taken from my old life. I just need to get away. Turn over a new leaf, you know?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Wait a minute... 'Taken'? 'Getaway'?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Are these clothes `stolen?!` Are you a shoplifter? I thought you looked like the trouble-making type!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are these clothes [color=#3b78e2][i]stolen?![/i][/color] Are you a shoplifter? I thought you looked like the trouble-making type!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? No! Well, actually, there's a complicated story ...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But the short version is that I'm poor now and I need `stupid` money to buy a gift for a `stupid` boy...
nodes.text_bbcode: But the short version is that I'm poor now and I need [color=#3b78e2][i]stupid[/i][/color] money to buy a gift for a [color=#3b78e2][i]stupid[/i][/color] boy...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Who is absolutely amazing and deserves the best gift possible.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Awww... Well, why didn't you `say` so? I'm a sucker for young love...
nodes.text_bbcode: Awww... Well, why didn't you [color=#3b78e2][i]say[/i][/color] so? I'm a sucker for young love...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's stubborn. And he's a pain. And he drives me crazy in the `worst` way.
nodes.text_bbcode: He's stubborn. And he's a pain. And he drives me crazy in the [color=#3b78e2][i]worst[/i][/color] way.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...But also, I guess, in the `best` way. And he deserves the best gift I can possibly afford. So here I am.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But also, I guess, in the [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] way. And he deserves the best gift I can possibly afford. So here I am.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Awww... That's so sweet! I'm a sucker for young love...

nodes.title: Give and Take
nodes.subtitle: Can Paige and Owen find the perfect gifts for each other?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
Later that day, at that very same mall...
Paige looks out the passenger side window as Owen pulls into a space in the mall's parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Remind me again why we're in your Grandma Betty's car and not your truck?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The truck's in the shop... Got a busted carburetor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This ride just doesn't feel the same, eh?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. It doesn't screech like a wounded animal whenever you touch the brakes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Says the girl constantly asking for rides.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm kidding! I know you love that junky old truck. Despite all logic.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, it's got personality... `and` cargo space.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, it's got personality... [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] cargo space.

nodes.text: Paige picks up her backpack, which is packed full to bursting...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Speaking of cargo... What's in the bag?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just... You know, textbooks. Might do some studying at the cafe if there's time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: First you go tough girl, now you're going bookworm? You know you can't just change images every time you get bored.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Says who? And you don't own the monopoly on studiousness, you know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right, all right. So are you gonna give the `tiniest` hint about what you want for Christmas?
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, all right. So are you gonna give the [color=#e23b3b][i]tiniest[/i][/color] hint about what you want for Christmas?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We talked about this. Nothing big. You know me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I `do` know you. So when you say 'nothing big', I know you really mean, 'This gift better be good.'
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] know you. So when you say 'nothing big', I know you really mean, 'This gift better be good.'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, what about you? What do I get for the guy who has everything? Or, you know... The guy who has cheap, junky things.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like you said, it's no big deal. It's the thought that counts.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...It's not like these gifts are gonna make or break our relationship.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Right! Of course. So, no pressure.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No pressure.
The two of them step out of the car and make their way towards the mall entrance.
They begin to cross the street, when suddenly--
`SKKRRRTT!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SKKRRRTT!![/b]

nodes.text: A limousine comes screeching to a halt, its bumper just inches away from Owen's knees!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa!
The back door opens, and a well dressed man steps out with a smug smile on his face...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I'm sorry, my friend! I didn't see you there...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Because I was in the backseat... Because I've hired a chauffer to drive for me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Cromwell.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cromwell.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Paige, my flower. Still consorting with `dirty weeds,` I see.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige, my flower. Still consorting with [color=#e23b3b][i]dirty weeds,[/i][/color] I see.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Keep talkin', Hedge Fund. You'll wish you traded that chauffer for a bodyguard.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: A Ha Ha! Such wit the common folk have!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing here, Cromwell? I already told you, there's `nothing` between us.
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing here, Cromwell? I already told you, there's [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing[/i][/color] between us.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Our meeting is happenstance, sweet Paige. You have come here shopping for cheap trinkets as holiday gifts, I assume.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And I have come shopping for businesses to expand my entrepreneurial ventures! What coincidence!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So you're here to gloat. I don't have time for this.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Nor I, truly. I'm planning to book a New Year's Eve cruise on the `S.S. Decadence.` Tickets are in short supply and high demand, so I must hurry off now.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nor I, truly. I'm planning to book a New Year's Eve cruise on the [color=#e23b3b][i]S.S. Decadence.[/i][/color] Tickets are in short supply and high demand, so I must hurry off now.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Maybe I'll see you two there! ...Though I very much doubt it, because I suspect you lack the funds! A Ha Ha!
Cromwell returns to his limo and rides off, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That spoiled little...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Forget about him. Look, I'll meet you back here this afternoon, and we'll exchange gifts then.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right. Sounds good.
Later, Paige walks into a trendy little boutique in the mall, where she approaches the clerk at the counter.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: How can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I hear your specialty is trading in vintage and secondhand clothes?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: That's correct. Are you interested in trading some items?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um. A few, yeah.
Paige takes off her backpack and empties its contents, spilling a cascade of clothes out onto the counter.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: These are the best pieces of my `old` wardrobe. I don't wear them much anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: These are the best pieces of my [color=#3b78e2][i]old[/i][/color] wardrobe. I don't wear them much anymore.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: I can see that. It's a much different style from your current look.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tell me about it. I just need to sell as much of this as possible.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Trust me, sweetie, I know the feeling. Any particular reason for the urgency?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually...
Cameron steps back...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Wait... That was your first kiss? Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes... Is that a problem?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Actually, it kind of is.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I don't know how to explain this...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I've kissed `a lot` of girls, $ALLISON.
nodes.text_bbcode: I've kissed [color=#e23b3b][i]a lot[/i][/color] of girls, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think I met some of them the other day...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're so smart and well-spoken, I think it's easy to forget just how young you are...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not `that` young.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] young.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Says the girl who just had her first kiss...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's not like you're that much older than me.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I know, I know... But I know the experiences I've had, I know what I'm about...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And I think I know what you deserve.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's really unfair.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You deserve someone better than me...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You deserve someone who can experience high school `with` you, not someone who's already been through it...
nodes.text_bbcode: You deserve someone who can experience high school [color=#e23b3b][i]with[/i][/color] you, not someone who's already been through it...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Don't do this!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: This... This was a mistake...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It wasn't...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ALLISON. I've... I've gotta go...
Cameron turns away from $ALLISON and heads back into the gym.
Unprepared for the heavy pain in her heart, $ALLISON collapses against the railing, her body shaking uncontrollably. The lights overhead blur as her eyes fill with tears.
A moment later, the door opens...
...And Erik steps out.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ALLISON? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No... I'm not at all okay!
Erik comes over and leans on the railing next to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Was it Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes! He... I don't know. We weren't together, but... He dumped me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I... Can't believe how much this hurts!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the point of opening your heart to anyone if this is what you feel in the end?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know it feels awful... I've been there before.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You... You have?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure... I've had tons of crushes on girls who wanted nothing to do with me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Even worse than that are the ones who wanted something to do with me... Until we spent more time together.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Does it ever get better?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think love gets better because you get better. Forgive me for discussing it in videogame terms, but...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The first time you get your heart broken... Well, that's kind of like when you get defeated on a boss level.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Then you press, 'Continue' and you try it again, and you make all this progress, and you get defeated again.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That seems like such a waste, Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It can feel that way... But along the way, you learn, and you get stronger, and at some point you do it. You find real love.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How has `this` made me stronger? I just got my heart broken...
nodes.text_bbcode: How has [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] made me stronger? I just got my heart broken...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, it was your first heartbreak, but I'm betting it was also your first dance, and your first kiss!
$ALLISON nods...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And not just any first kiss... A Cameron kiss!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee! Stop trying to make me laugh!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This, this right here is a first for me, too, you know?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What is?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's my first, very personal, consoling, helping-$ALLISON-in-need moment!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's a specific moment.
$ALLISON sniffles, her eyes clearing up...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How'd you know I was out here?
Erik fiddles with his glasses.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, just a hunch!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad you came...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, what'd I miss in there?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's see...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Kimi and Spencer came to the dance together...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I saw.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I think they just came as friends. I don't know how much you care, since you just kissed Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hear he's been number one on Kimi's Pecking Order for five months straight!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wish I knew what it was like to kiss a `number one` like Cameron!
nodes.text_bbcode: I wish I knew what it was like to kiss a [color=#e23b3b][i]number one[/i][/color] like Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know, if Cameron were my preferred gender.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about Paige and Owen?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh! Ha! They got into a dance-off and then Paige and Lee left to go have some 'rich people fun.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whatever that is...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And then Owen and Maria were right behind them, leaving to go have 'actual fun.' Owen's words.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee. And what about you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, put a twist in my pretzel! Turns out, Delilah's father agreed to let me come over for Thanksgiving Dinner!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's splendid!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She invited the whole gang too... Are you in?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd be delighted.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So it'll be you guys and me and Delilah...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: On a date... With her dad... I've never been more happy and afraid at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Don't worry, we'll be there to help you out!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hope so!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Anyway, thank you so much, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: For tonight. For our first very personal consoling `friend` moment.
nodes.text_bbcode: For tonight. For our first very personal consoling [color=#3b78e2][i]friend[/i][/color] moment.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hopefully, the first of many!
You have reached the end of `Season 2, Episode 2: Homecoming Kiss!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 2, Episode 2: Homecoming Kiss![/b]

nodes.text: Did you miss what happened this summer?! A New Start 7: Summer Showdowns is available now in More Episodes!
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!
Mr. Horner takes the ax from Erik with a scowl.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Maybe leave the log splitting to me.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: You should go on back to the others. I'm sure they could use you in the kitchen.
Erik hangs his head, nodding dutifully.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: All right... But you should know that I may not be as helpful as you think.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm allergic to peanuts. And mangos. And possibly crawfish, although I've never had crawfish...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I also get queasy if I see mayonaise, or anything that looks like mayonaise...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Also, I lack the forearm strength for heavy mixing, vigorous egg-beating, repeated slicing motions...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Fine! Enough. Just come with me.
You are now playing as Spencer.
Back in the kitchen, the rest of the Troublemakers work on preparing dinner.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Thanks for the help, everyone. I just really want everything to go perfect tonight.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We get it, we get it. Stop worrying... No one's going to burn your precious bundt.
Paige, Allison, and Owen set off to prepare ingredients, but Kimi hangs back.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hee hee, I think it's sweet! Delilah, you must like Erik a lot to be so concerned.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I do, but there's more to it than that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh? I smell a story! Is it a secret? I bet there's a secret!
Delilah stammers uncomfortably...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It's just... Um...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe I should step in...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kimi, why don't you...

options.label: Get started on chopping those onions?

nodes.text: Just then, a snort sounds from the barn entrance, and a huge, horned shadow looms over Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no! Penelope's husband!
The bull bellows angrily, stomping a hoof and lowering his horns toward Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's not what it looks like, Mr. Bull! I wasn't stealing the milk meant for your children!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I was, but it was for a good cause! ...Baked goods!
The bull inches closer menacingly!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay, okay! I'll share the baked goods!
The bull tromps forward! Erik scrambles away in a panic!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Aaaah!
Erik runs around the barn, flailing like a panicked chicken as he flees the approaching bull!
Suddenly, he trips!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Aah!
Erik stumbles to the ground! ...The bull bears down on him, charging closer and closer...
...When Mr. Horner steps right into his path!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Without a word, Mr. Horner stares the bull in the eyes! It stops in its path!
Just inches away, from the bull's deadly horns, Mr. Horner glares at the animal with a frightening, unwavering focus! They face off, neither budging an inch, until...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't believe it!
...The bull backs up, turns, and flees!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How did you do that?
Mr. Horner helps Erik to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Things in this world will try to push you. Scare you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: That's when you gotta stand your ground.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Show some strength, and the world will respect you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We should call the police!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh no, I think Owen might be involved somehow...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: There's no time to get you all caught up, sweetie, here...
She hands a set of keys to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Take my car to the warehouse. Those boys are the worst kind of trouble, and my Owie will need you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Your car? Do you even have a car?
You are now playing as Owen.
Outside the charity warehouse on Industrial, as night falls...
...Owen pulls up in Sal's black-cherry sports car and lets the car idle. Sal turns to Dom and Big Jon in the backseat.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Here's the plan, knuckleheads.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Wait... Should we say it in front of, you know, `him?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Should we say it in front of, you know, [color=#e23b3b][i]him?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Yeah, I think it's safe to say Owen's officially an accomplice at this point.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: He's an accountant?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: He's `in.`
nodes.text_bbcode: He's [color=#e23b3b][i]in.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And once I do this, I don't owe you anything.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: You really think this is going to make up for me being locked up for a year?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That wasn't `my` fault!
nodes.text_bbcode: That wasn't [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] fault!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: But you didn't get caught! You got away!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And you wouldn't have done the same?!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Whatever. Let's just focus on why we're here...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Here's the deal. Every holiday season, all these charities make donations requests on behalf of kids who want to play videogames.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: The people donate, the charities buy the latest game consoles, and then it all gets shipped to a warehouse.
Sal points at a big, glass door with bars across the front.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: This is that warehouse. Inside are boxes and boxes of consoles.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: How many?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Fifty? A hundred? And each one we can sell for a hundred bucks a pop.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: That's like five hundred dollars!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: It's five `thousand,` moron!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's five [color=#e23b3b][i]thousand,[/i][/color] moron!

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Whoa! That's way more!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Yeah, and it's ours for the taking...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you guys serious?! Those are supposed to go to `kids!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you guys serious?! Those are supposed to go to [color=#e23b3b][i]kids![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: And you don't think the charity will find a way to get more consoles to them after we take 'em?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! I don't!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Pfft! What happened to you, man? When did you become such a wuss?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know. When did you become...
`FWOOSH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]FWOOSH![/b]

nodes.text: The tires burst! The car comes to a squealing halt not far from where the cop cars are...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess that ends that...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, I was standing by the statues, watching patiently to see if the polar bear would blink... And he never did!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Amanda, did people think `you` were a statue too?
nodes.text_bbcode: Amanda, did people think [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] were a statue too?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's silly!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Although a janitor `did` brush my shoulders off with a feather duster. I thought he was just being nice!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Although a janitor [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] brush my shoulders off with a feather duster. I thought he was just being nice!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...So now what?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure we can find our way out. Maybe we can split up. I'll go with Amanda, Spencer will go with $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hmm?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't you see this is a dream come true? If we have the chance to spend the night in Santa's Village, we should do it! And we should do it `together!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you see this is a dream come true? If we have the chance to spend the night in Santa's Village, we should do it! And we should do it [color=#3b78e2][i]together![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer looks to $ALLISON, who is lost in thought. She looks out over Santa's Village, the twinkling Christmas lights even more stunning at night. Her eyes are wide with astonishment, her mouth curling into a smile...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What the heck. We might as well enjoy this, right?
The four of them spend the night having snowball fights with artificial snow...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Direct hit!
Decorating and re-decorating their surroundings...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oooh, pretty lights!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ugh, that scarf is `all` wrong for that snowman. And that hat? `So` five seasons ago. I'm gonna need a department store run, stat!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, that scarf is [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] wrong for that snowman. And that hat? [color=#3b78e2][i]So[/i][/color] five seasons ago. I'm gonna need a department store run, stat!

nodes.text: ...And finally, settling in for storytime by a cardboard fireplace in the village.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Once upon a time, during WrestleFest's SantaSlam 2011, Bashin' Bobby Bashwell challenged El Destructivo to a Reindeer Rules Cage Match for the coveted Blizzard Belt...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Reindeer Rules? So a winner can only be only be declared by 10-count? No pinfalls or submissions?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ah, you've been paying attention!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee hee...
After hours of stories and laughter, the four of them eventually drift off to sleep...
The next morning...
Spencer opens his eyes and finds himself lying in a fluffy bank of artificial snow on Sugar Plum Lane.
... He turns to find $ALLISON resting her head on his shoulder, still sleeping. As he stirs, she slowly awakens.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh! M... Morning, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Morning.
$ALLISON sits up and straightens her hair, blushing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So what did you think of your first trip to Santa's Village?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Honestly? I had a great time. Better than I ever would have imagined.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sure, some traditions are silly, or logically unsound. But I think that's okay... Especially if you're with the right people.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you? Was our holiday adventure everything you wanted it to be?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well...
Spencer thinks back sadly to Kimi's words... A 'magical, romantic moment'...
But $ALLISON smiles at him, warmly and genuinely, and he puts the thought away.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...It was great. Couldn't ask for anything more.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm glad!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, look! Another holiday tradition!
Spencer follows $ALLISON's gaze upward... To the `mistletoe` hanging from a candy cane lamppost just above them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer follows $ALLISON's gaze upward... To the [b]mistletoe[/b] hanging from a candy cane lamppost just above them.

nodes.text: Before he can say anything, $ALLISON gives him a quick kiss on the cheek!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Heheh... Come on, the others should be waking up soon.
She gets up and walks across the lane towards Kimi and Amanda... Leaving Spencer with a lingering smile still on his face.
Cameron holds out his arm, and $ALLISON takes it.
The two of them head over toward a table at the edge of the dance floor, where Erik is sitting and smiling.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Howdy! You two look like a magazine cover!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Is that good?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why are you so happy, Erik? Was Delilah able to come?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The opposite, actually!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Apparently, if she'd come to the dance with me, it would've officially been our first date!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But she's not allowed to date without her father's permission!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, she's not here, I'll never get permission from him, and our relationship's completely doomed!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're taking it pretty well, dude.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Agreed. Why are you so cheerful?
Erik holds up his phone.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just discovered emoticons! I sent Delilah one that does a funny animation of a heart breaking in two!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The heart is mine, b.t.w....

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Aww, Erik, I'm `so` sorry...
nodes.text_bbcode: Aww, Erik, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay... I'm used to this kind of thing... Nerds like me aren't really father-impressers...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I hope you can still find merriment tonight.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too. There's always texting, right?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suppose so...
Erik returns his attention to his phone, and $ALLISON and Cameron move on...
You are now playing as Paige...
Paige marches into the dance, pulling Lee along by the hand!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: This is a pretty cool setup. I'm kind of excited to be here with you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah yeah yeah! Just come with me onto the dance floor!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Uh... Okay.
Paige drags Lee out to the center of the dance floor!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I guess you `really` want to dance!
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess you [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] want to dance!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't stand there! You're blocking my view of the front... Er, of you!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I'm blocking your view of the front of me? How does that make sense?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just move over here!
A second later, Owen arrives...
...With Maria on his arm!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maria!
Lee turns toward the entrance.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Is that who you wanted to see? Is this some kind of weird cat-fighting thing?
You are now playing as Erik.
Mr. Horner leads Erik out to a pen at the back of his property.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: When you said you had a 'turkey' out back, you meant like a frozen turkey, right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Nope.
He points to the fenced enclosure, where a lone, fat turkey waddles around, warbling.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: If we're gonna eat, you're gonna have to grab that bird.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And... And... Kill it?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: That's usually how it goes, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm... Not sure I can do that, Mr. Horner.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: I'm `telling` you what to do. Are you defying me in my own home?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]telling[/i][/color] you what to do. Are you defying me in my own home?

nodes.text: Erik shrinks away.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: N... No, sir!
Mr. Horner points to the pen sternly, waiting. Erik looks over to the unassuming turkey...
It stares back at him, cocking its head sideways as it gobbles curiously...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Such a noble, nonjudgmental creature!
Erik swallows, and decides to...
Later, everyone sits at the dinner table, admiring the stunning spread before them.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: This is amazing. Thank you all `so` much for helping out!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is amazing. Thank you all [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much for helping out!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Everything looks soooo yummy!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. Who needs turkey when Spencer is secretly a fancy cuisine prodigy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?! No I'm not!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know French delicacies when I see them. How do you explain that `coq au vin` you made?
nodes.text_bbcode: I know French delicacies when I see them. How do you explain that [color=#3b78e2][i]coq au vin[/i][/color] you made?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean my `Drunken Style Chicken Surprise?` I made that up while watching kung fu movies.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean my [color=#e23b3b][i]Drunken Style Chicken Surprise?[/i][/color] I made that up while watching kung fu movies.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And this `poulet cordon bleu?`
nodes.text_bbcode: And this [color=#3b78e2][i]poulet cordon bleu?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Bodyslam Bird with Cheese.` Perfect when watching wrestling.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Bodyslam Bird with Cheese.[/i][/color] Perfect when watching wrestling.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Spencer, you made a perfect `boeuf a la bourguinon!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer, you made a perfect [color=#3b78e2][i]boeuf a la bourguinon![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's just `Gridiron Beef-Splosion,` my gameday specialty!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's just [color=#e23b3b][i]Gridiron Beef-Splosion,[/i][/color] my gameday specialty!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I give up. I haven't eaten this well since I was rich. I'm just gonna sit back and enjoy it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Amen to that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm definitely thankful for all the food and friendship in the room right now, and for the Horners' hospitality...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Anyone? `'Thankful'?` That was a cue, people!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Anyone? [color=#3b78e2][i]'Thankful'?[/i][/color] That was a cue, people!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh... Are we really doing the 'what are we thankful for' thing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Yes.` So stop acting tough and let yourself be corny for a minute!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes.[/i][/color] So stop acting tough and let yourself be corny for a minute!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, if Paige is too stubborn, I'll start.
Owen and Paige both look up from their plates. Their eyes meet for just a moment...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm thankful that we can sit down and put our problems aside. Together. At least for a while.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Um... All of us, that is!
Paige hides the beginnings of a smile.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... Put me down for what he said.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I'm thankful for sports radio, good cooking oil, and for you guys. Every last one of ya.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And that's as sappy as I'm gonna get.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm thankful for our camaraderie, and for the relief it grants me from all my trivial worries...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...And also for `mashed potatoes.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And also for [color=#3b78e2][i]mashed potatoes.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What about you, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me? That's easy. I'm thankful for...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We've gotta get to the freeway! That's where the guys are heading!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then turn right here!
Owen turns right, the tires squealing!
A second later, one of the police cars careens onto the street behind him!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh...
The squad car catches up, blaring over the intercom...

nodes.speaker: Police
nodes.text: This is the police. Pull over. We know you've stolen the consoles.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Left here!
Owen veers left, the cop right on his tail!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's that ahead?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh again...
Up ahead, a police officer throws down a long metallic strip!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's a spike strip!
A few winding turns later, and...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's the freeway!
A black-cherry car takes the ramp ahead of them!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And there are the guys!
Suddenly, several cop cars arrange themselves ahead, forming a blockade! Owen accelerates toward it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing?! There's no speeding through this one!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hold onto something!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't like that you said that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's been a while since I pulled this move...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just have to `spin the wheel, pull the emergency brake, and drift...` I just hope Grandma's car can take it!
nodes.text_bbcode: I just have to [color=#e23b3b][i]spin the wheel, pull the emergency brake, and drift...[/i][/color] I just hope Grandma's car can take it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Move?! What move?! Why are you pulling a move?!
They reach the cop cars!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here goes nothing!
Kimi leads Spencer, pulling him toward Sugar Plum Street after $ALLISON and Amanda. When they meet up, Kimi pulls Amanda aside once more.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda... Do you know anything about polar bears?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sure! They're the largest carnivorous mammals on land!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm not sure these decorative statues of polar bears are scientifically accurate.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, they all have scarves and ice skates, so... No.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And they also don't `blink` like real polar bears! Amanda, have you ever noticed them blinking?
nodes.text_bbcode: And they also don't [color=#3b78e2][i]blink[/i][/color] like real polar bears! Amanda, have you ever noticed them blinking?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No! But I could watch them to make sure!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's a great idea!
Kimi nudges Spencer with her elbow as Amanda leaves to inspect the bears.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You should take $ALLISON to get a closer look at one of these buildings. And quick, before Amanda gets back!
Spencer looks to the display and spots two buildings with open doors. A tall, rickety clock tower overlooking the whole village, and a small but elaborately decorated pink cottage...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hmm... I guess I'll take her to see...
...He has failed.

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Time for some grammar!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How about writing a sample sentence that uses both 'you're' and 'your' in the correct way!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: There's... A correct way?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sure! 'Your' is possessive as in 'your car' or 'your friend'.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And 'you're' is a contraction of 'you are.' As in, 'you're looking nice today' or 'you're welcome to come over.'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay... Let me try this.

options.label: Your friend thinks you're a good tutor!
Your looking at you're watch again!

nodes.text: $ALLISON scoots right next to Spencer, her leg brushing against his.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Girl touch!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay... So, a `veneer` is an attractive outer layer that disguises someone or something's true nature or feelings.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay... So, a [color=#3b78e2][i]veneer[/i][/color] is an attractive outer layer that disguises someone or something's true nature or feelings.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Disguises its true feelings, huh?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Must... Concentrate on learning words... Not on $ALLISON!
It's the night of the Homecoming Dance!
As $ALLISON and Cameron enter, $ALLISON marvels at the lights, the decorations, and the crowd of dressed-up students!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's so beautiful...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I was thinking the same thing about you.
She blushes.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Should we get straight to dancing?
$ALLISON can feel her knees shaking!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Owwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Owwww![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The play ends and Owen runs over from the sideline.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you okay, buddy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I... I think `I broke my other leg!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I think [color=#e23b3b][i]I broke my other leg![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As a team of emergency medical staff runs over with a gurney, Spencer knows...
...He has failed.

nodes.text: Spencer takes a step onto the field, and pain flares from his leg.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ignore the pain, Spencer... This is for Steelman! This is for the win!
Spencer lines up and stares at the opposing quarterback.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's go time.
The center hikes the ball to the quarterback!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've got to get past the offensive line!
...He has failed.
