nodes.text: A moment later, a cop is rapping his knuckles against the window. Owen rolls it down...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Officer...
He can only barely begin to comprehend just how much trouble he's in, but he knows vaguely that...
Paige reaches down and unstraps her heels!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: These are high-end heels that I got on-sale! They're like my `best` pair of shoes!
nodes.text_bbcode: These are high-end heels that I got on-sale! They're like my [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] pair of shoes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Now,` Paige!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Now,[/i][/color] Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Just keep your eyes on the road.
She rolls down her window, sticks her head out, cocks her arm back, brings it forward, and...
Owen spins the wheel, pulls the emergency brake, and drifts through the blockade, the car spinning perfectly through the arrangement of cop cars as if guided by an unseen hand.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Woohoo!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How?! What?!
Owen spins the wheel back, drops the brake, and floors the gas, accelerating ahead, out the other side, and onto the freeway!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where did you learn this?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We can talk about that later! Right now, we've gotta catch up to the guys!
Owen weaves carefully and methodically through traffic, keeping the black-cherry car in sight.
A police siren wails behind him!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I really don't like when you say that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought that the guys would have the consoles in the back of the car!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah? So?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look! I don't see them!
Up ahead, except for Big Jon, the back of the black-cherry car seems empty.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They're probably in the trunk, unless they--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Haha! The trunk! That's perfect!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? 'Cause we might have different definitions of perfect!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sal popped it open earlier! If we can hit it with something, it'll pop and the cops'll see the stolen consoles...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, `so` easy! We'll just hit their trunk with an object on the `freeway` in the middle of a `high speed chase!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] easy! We'll just hit their trunk with an object on the [color=#3b78e2][i]freeway[/i][/color] in the middle of a [color=#3b78e2][i]high speed chase![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not we... `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not we... [color=#e23b3b][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, no more football for you. You've officially suffered head trauma.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't do it! I'm driving!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're serious about this?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's our only chance!
Owen accelerates toward the black-cherry car, pulling up right behind it...
You are now playing as Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What am I supposed to throw?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know! Find something!
Paige looks behind her into the backseat of the car...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This car is spotless! There's nothing in it! There's nothing to throw!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, why don't you throw... Um... Why don't you throw your shoes?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you have a better idea?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah! How about I throw you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Seriously, you have to do it, Paige! I'm not going to be able to tail them for much longer!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Urrg! I can't believe I'm gonna do this!
Owen floors the gas, and the car shoots forward!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhhhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Up ahead is a T-intersection. Two police cars turn onto the street!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you gonna do?
Seeing Owen's car, they turn, tires screeching, trying to form a blockade!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, what are you gonna do?!
Owen eyes the closing gap between the cars!

nodes.title: The Tutors
nodes.subtitle: $ALLISON becomes Spencer's tutor... Will he ask her to the dance?

nodes.text: At the end of a long school day, $ALLISON leaves her last class...
...And heads straight for detention.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Woo hee! I can't wait for detention! I've been looking forward to this all day!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Five friends! One room! Mandatory attendance! It's like completing my bucket list in one swoop!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This isn't precisely the manner in which I imagined I'd be spending the halcyon days of my youth...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But I agree. At least we now have several friends with whom we can pass the hours.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Though I must admit, there's one face I'm looking forward to seeing above all others...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You mean Spencer, don't you? Sounds like someone's got a little `crush`ed ice in her snow cone!
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean Spencer, don't you? Sounds like someone's got a little [color=#e23b3b][i]crush[/i][/color]ed ice in her snow cone!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I merely meant to voice my pleasure regarding his return from the hospital!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whatever you say!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Jumping beans! This place is even better than I remember.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Chairs with fabric instead of plastic... and windows without a half-inch of grime!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I must admit, the lack of exposed pipes and missing ceiling tiles is impressive.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I could get used to this place.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not bad for a room in a public high school.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's nice to finally hang out somewhere that doesn't look like the 'before' segment of a home improvement show!
Spencer awkwardly navigates with his crutches in between two couches.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stupid! Couches!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Poor Spencer... Look at him leaning on his crutches!
$ALLISON approaches Spencer, as he sits alone on a couch.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sup, Red. How's things?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Things are...
The next morning...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Spencer! Long time no talk!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sorry, buddy! I've just been busy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I heard about the yearlong detention. That's pretty rough.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Want me to try to get you out of it?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually... It's not so bad.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That smile... There's a girl there you like, isn't there!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Am I really that easy to read?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like a book...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's... $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The cute redhead who's always hanging out with you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yep.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So are you going to ask her to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe. She's tutoring me today. I was thinking if things go well...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Maybe I'll ask her to the dance at the end of the session!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why not just ask her as soon as you get there?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's just say it would kind of kill the tutoring vibe if she shoots me down before we start studying.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good point... How are you going to ask her?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: With words.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, Spencer, Spencer... Don't you pay attention to the world around you at all?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't just `ask` a girl to Homecoming! You have to hire a guy to sky-write it with a plane...
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't just [color=#e23b3b][i]ask[/i][/color] a girl to Homecoming! You have to hire a guy to sky-write it with a plane...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Or create an elaborate cake, with the words 'Homecoming, my princess?' written on the top.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think I have a box of cake mix at home...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think you're missing the point.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Listen, Ben...
You are now playing as $ALLISON.
In the hallway after school, $ALLISON, Kimi, and Paige are walking toward detention. All around them, students are buzzing about the Homecoming Dance!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess Homecoming is kind of a monumental occasion...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! It's huge! And I cannot believe Cameron asked you to the dance! That was like amazing and just... `Ahhhh!` The best!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding?! It's huge! And I cannot believe Cameron asked you to the dance! That was like amazing and just... [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhh![/i][/color] The best!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So Cameron asked her... What's the big deal?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're just upset because no guy's asked you yet.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've been asked plenty. But only by gross guys. The kind with velcro wallets.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If I might interject... I thought 'gross' was kind of your preferred type. I mean, that's what you're always calling Owen, and--
Kimi pinches $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think it's obvious who Paige won't be going with... A guy we `shouldn't mention by name.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think it's obvious who Paige won't be going with... A guy we [color=#3b78e2][i]shouldn't mention by name.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, right...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. You don't have to treat me like I'm made of glass. Owen and I are...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Mortal enemies?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Well, it's way, `way` more complicated than that...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Well, it's way, [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] more complicated than that...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, about that... I've been meaning to ask you...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A while back we were volunteering to deliver food for the Troublemakers program, and you and Owen went into that kitchen together...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: The two of you looked very angry when you came out, but then I saw you smiling...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't remember that!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ever since then, you've been acting rather odd toward each other.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Odd? We're not acting odd! You're odd!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It seems like the two of you are alone all the time.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's almost like you're...
$ALLISON notices Paige's eyes go wide!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Like they're what?
Out on the dance floor, Cameron puts his arms around $ALLISON, and she nervously puts her hands on his shoulders.
They sway to the music...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, this is dancing with a guy. It's... Nice.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Penny for the thoughts behind that smile?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think this thought costs more than a penny.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why don't you tell me about it outside?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Outside?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah, come on, let's get some air.
Cameron grabs her hand and starts leading her away...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This is it... This is how he's going to kiss me!
Outside, Cameron leads her to a railing, and they lean against it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's pleasant out here...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: One perk of California winter.
$ALLISON looks up at the stars in the night sky...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: When my sister Amanda and I were really little, we used to make up our own constellations.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That must have been cute.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd always find them, and she'd name them. I remember she called one of them 'Gus', and we thought that was the funniest thing. Especially--
$ALLISON looks back at Cameron, noticing just how close he is to her, their arms touching, his face and eyes filling her vision.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What? Why'd you stop?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nothing. I... I got distracted.
Cameron reaches out and sweeps a lock of hair away from $ALLISON's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're not like your sister...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I wouldn't think so.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're not like any girl I've ever met...
$ALLISON can feel herself blushing.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I've always liked you... Even when I first met you...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're `so` smart, and `so` beautiful.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] smart, and [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron, I don't--
Cameron cups her face in his warm hand, and $ALLISON looks up at him...

nodes.title: A Troublemakers Thanksgiving
nodes.subtitle: Can Erik impress Delilah's no-nonsense father?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Erik.
The Troublemakers gather on the dirt road out in front of the Horner Farm, following Erik as he makes his way to the front gate.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for coming with me, guys. I was a little nervous when Delilah invited me over to her farm for Thanksgiving dinner.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Her dad's a pretty intense guy, but I think I've made some progress with him lately. Plus, if you guys have my back, I'm sure I'll be fine as a fiddle!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No problem, man. We're happy to help.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Speak for yourself, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...But I suppose I didn't have anything better to do, so here I am!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, as long as free food is involved, I'm there!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah! Besides, the six of us haven't done anything together since Homecoming!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If it's all the same to you, I'd rather not talk about Homecoming.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It, uh, didn't go well for you, $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That would be a gross understatement. Let's just say that Cameron is not who I thought he was.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well... I for one had a `great` time at Homecoming with Lee.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I for one had a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] time at Homecoming with Lee.

nodes.text: Paige flashes a glance toward Owen, searching for his reaction.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, right... yeah, Homecoming was awesome! Maria and I had a blast!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, `my` night was the opposite of blast. It was a gravitational implosion. And yet here we are, still talking about it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] night was the opposite of blast. It was a gravitational implosion. And yet here we are, still talking about it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well... Maybe you just need to get your mind off things.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And what better way to do that than with some grub?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suppose so...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...At least a turkey won't try to decide what's best for me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's true. Turkeys are noble, nonjudgmental creatures.
Just then, the farmhouse door opens, and Delilah walks out to greet the Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hi Erik! Hi everyone! It's great to have you all over for Thanksgiving.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Delilah! Hello!
Delilah beckons Erik aside, away from the group. Erik straightens his posture and smooths his hair. As Delilah approaches, he leans in and...
You are now playing as Spencer.
Back in the kitchen, Spencer and $ALLISON put the finishing touches on a pot of soup...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right... Now, just a little more seasoning.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How much hot sauce should I add? A dash?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: As much as you're brave enough for!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Two` dashes!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Two[/i][/color] dashes!

nodes.text: The two share a laugh as $ALLISON adds the seasoning to the pot.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think you were right, Spencer. Keeping busy was just what I needed.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm impressed, Spencer! You really pulled this team together!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You even got Owen and Paige to stop fighting for a minute!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess hitting meat with a spiky hammer is a great way to blow off some steam.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. For the record though, I probably tenderized a little better than Owen did.
Just then, Spencer notices Delilah pacing nervously. He sidles over to her.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Potatoes are done... Yams are done... What am I forgetting? Come on, think, think, think...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Everything all right, Delilah? You look like you're stressing out!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I am! I just wanted everything to go right for this dinner...
The rest of the Troublemakers gather to see what the matter is.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's just dinner, Delilah. I'm sure everything will be fine.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It's more than that! I just... I'm too embarrassed to say.
Kimi puts a hand on her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't have to be embarrassed. Whatever it is, we're all here to help.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well... Before my mom passed away, `she` was the one in charge of Thanksgiving dinners. My dad was always at his happiest when he was sitting down for her cooking.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... Before my mom passed away, [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] was the one in charge of Thanksgiving dinners. My dad was always at his happiest when he was sitting down for her cooking.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: My parents always told me they fell in love over the perfect home-cooked meal.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I thought that if I made a good enough dinner, my dad would be more lenient, and Erik and I...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Not that I wanted Erik to fall in `love` with me! I just... Like him a lot, is all...
nodes.text_bbcode: Not that I wanted Erik to fall in [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] with me! I just... Like him a lot, is all...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awwww... That is so sweet!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It's been weighing on my mind... I'm afraid it's going to make me forget something!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't worry! We've got the sides done, the stuffing, the gravy, the cranberry sauce... Everything we need for a perfect Turkey Day!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Speaking of which... Where is the turkey?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: `The turkey?!` Oh no oh no oh no!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]The turkey?![/i][/color] Oh no oh no oh no!

nodes.text: Delilah rushes over to the oven and pulls open the door, letting loose a plume of dark smoke!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: `Koff! Koff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Koff! Koff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The Troublemakers rush to help her, pulling the burnt, blackened turkey out of the oven! They open the windows to air out the smoky room.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no!
Just then, the back door opens as Mr. Horner and Erik enter, sniffing curiously.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Something burning in here? Everyone okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The turkey!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, everyone...
Erik rushes to Delilah's side and puts a comforting hand on her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't worry, Delilah. Everything's gonna be okay! I'm gonna do everything I can to make sure this dinner goes perfectly for you!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh, Erik... That's so sweet!
Delilah takes Erik's hand, smiling sweetly... Until Mr. Horner clears his throat loudly.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: We've got a turkey out back, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: If you're serious about making this right, here's your chance.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Gulp...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gulp...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You are now playing as Erik.
Mr. Horner leads Erik out to a pen at the back of his property.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: When you said you had a 'turkey' out back, you meant like a frozen turkey, right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Nope.
He points to the fenced enclosure, where a lone, fat turkey waddles around, warbling.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: If we're gonna eat, you're gonna have to grab that bird.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And... And... Kill it?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: That's usually how it goes, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm... Not sure I can do that, Mr. Horner.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: I'm `telling` you what to do. Are you defying me in my own home?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]telling[/i][/color] you what to do. Are you defying me in my own home?

nodes.text: Erik shrinks away.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: N... No, sir!
Mr. Horner points to the pen sternly, waiting. Erik looks over to the unassuming turkey...
It stares back at him, cocking its head sideways as it gobbles curiously...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Such a noble, nonjudgmental creature!
Erik swallows, and decides to...
You are now playing as Spencer.
It's Friday, and Spencer is psyching himself up for the last game of the season.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How's it going? Are you `actually` angry or just practicing your angry face?
nodes.text_bbcode: How's it going? Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] angry or just practicing your angry face?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just getting in my zone.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I see you're off crutches for the first time today... Leg feeling okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope. But that's not going to keep me out of the game.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get out of my zone, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure thing, buddy. Good luck!
Owen leaves, and Spencer slips on his headphones.
He starts listening to some music, pumping himself up...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You can do this, Spencer...
The music pulses through him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `You can do this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You can do this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Suddenly, someone pulls the headphones off of Spencer's ears!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hope I'm not interrupting.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You are, actually.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I just thought we should talk real quick...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm worried about you, Spencer. I don't want you to go out there and get yourself hurt.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: More like you don't want me to play so that I lose my spot in the Steelman Program!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I `do` happen to be the first guy on the waiting list...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] happen to be the first guy on the waiting list...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Honestly, though, lately I've been too preoccupied with my love life to worry about football.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't have time to sit around and talk about girls with you!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh, but I'm sure you'll want to talk about this particular girl...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My new friend, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A girl like $ALLISON wouldn't even give you the time of day, creep.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Then why do I have `this photo` on my phone?
nodes.text_bbcode: Then why do I have [color=#e23b3b][i]this photo[/i][/color] on my phone?

nodes.text: Nate takes out his phone... And shows a picture of himself and $ALLISON, cuddled close together!

nodes.title: Getaway
nodes.subtitle: Owen's past finally catches up to him. Can he escape?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
Paige gets off the bus in Owen's neighborhood...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is it!
...She walks to Owen's house and stomps up the walkway...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Time to give Owen a piece of my mind!
She knocks, rapping her knuckles hard against the front door.
A moment later, the door opens a crack, and Owen peeks out. Seeing Paige, he opens it all the way.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hi to you too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You shouldn't be here right now! It's not safe!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about, and I don't care! We need to talk!
Owen cranes his neck out, peering at the front yard and the street beyond.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm serious... You should go.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm serious too! I'm done with sneaking around and making out in broom closets. I need to know `what we are.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm serious too! I'm done with sneaking around and making out in broom closets. I need to know [color=#3b78e2][i]what we are.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen looks at her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I knew that'd get your attention!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, okay. We can talk, but... Just make it quick, okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever! I'll talk as long as I need to. And right now, I need to talk about Homecoming!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What about it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know that you only went with Maria because I went with Lee...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And yeah, I `said` that I had a really good time with him...
nodes.text_bbcode: And yeah, I [color=#3b78e2][i]said[/i][/color] that I had a really good time with him...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait, you didn't?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen tries the door, but it doesn't give! He bangs on it, trying to force it open with his shoulder...
...But it still doesn't budge.
In the distance, Owen hears the wailing of police sirens.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's it then... This is how it ends.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The police are going to get here, and then I'm going to be arrested, and then my life is basically over.
He hangs his head, pressing it to the glass...
...When he hears a familiar voice from outside.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige?! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Saving you, duh! P.S. You're welcome!
She removes the broom handle from the door and pulls it open!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Listen, the cops are going to show up any second! We can't be here when they are, or I'll be taken away!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This way!
Paige leads Owen toward Grandma Betty's car, a faded green 1970's rusted relic with a thin coat of dust on it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What did you do to get into this mess?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's complicated! If I didn't help them, they were going to hurt my grandma!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great friends you used to have!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is this honestly the time for judging?! Give me the keys!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who says `you` get to drive?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Who says [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] get to drive?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? We're going to have this argument now? Just trust me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Urrg! Fine!
Paige reluctantly flips Owen the keys, and they get in!
The sirens grow louder...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The only way I'm ever getting out of this is if I can prove that I didn't steal anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ahem... Did you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No!
The sirens are deafening, almost upon them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's too late! We're not gonna outrun the cops!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's exactly what we're gonna do.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There's something I've never told you about me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You'll see! Just buckle up and hold onto something!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've seen you drive before, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, you really haven't.
Owen floors the gas, and the car shoots forward!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhhhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Up ahead is a T-intersection. Two police cars turn onto the street!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you gonna do?
Seeing Owen's car, they turn, tires screeching, trying to form a blockade!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, what are you gonna do?!
Owen eyes the closing gap between the cars!

nodes.title: Christmas Stories
nodes.subtitle: What are the Troublemakers up to during Winter Break?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Kimi.
The Troublemakers gather for their last detention session before the Winter Break.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All right, Troublemakers. I only have you for one more day before I cut you loose for two whole weeks, so we're gonna do something special...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no... Here it comes...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're gonna have to do some crazy impossible task, aren't we?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, like shovel snow out of every driveway in Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or knit sweaters for the homeless out of recycled cardboard...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Or accelerate matter beyond the speed of light...
The group silently turns to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...Which is `also impossible,` guys.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Which is [color=#3b78e2][i]also impossible,[/i][/color] guys.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No, it's nothing like that.
Ms. Lee flips on a radio and opens a box on her desk...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: ...The six of you are to enjoy these festive cookies and listen to holiday carols for the remainder of your hour in detention.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wuh?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This... Can't be for real!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Guys, I think Ms. Lee is being...

nodes.title: Give and Take
nodes.subtitle: Can Paige and Owen find the perfect gifts for each other?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
Later that day, at that very same mall...
Paige looks out the passenger side window as Owen pulls into a space in the mall's parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Remind me again why we're in your Grandma Betty's car and not your truck?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The truck's in the shop... Got a busted carburetor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This ride just doesn't feel the same, eh?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. It doesn't screech like a wounded animal whenever you touch the brakes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Says the girl constantly asking for rides.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm kidding! I know you love that junky old truck. Despite all logic.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, it's got personality... `and` cargo space.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, it's got personality... [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] cargo space.

nodes.text: Paige picks up her backpack, which is packed full to bursting...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Speaking of cargo... What's in the bag?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just... You know, textbooks. Might do some studying at the cafe if there's time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: First you go tough girl, now you're going bookworm? You know you can't just change images every time you get bored.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Says who? And you don't own the monopoly on studiousness, you know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right, all right. So are you gonna give the `tiniest` hint about what you want for Christmas?
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, all right. So are you gonna give the [color=#e23b3b][i]tiniest[/i][/color] hint about what you want for Christmas?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We talked about this. Nothing big. You know me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I `do` know you. So when you say 'nothing big', I know you really mean, 'This gift better be good.'
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] know you. So when you say 'nothing big', I know you really mean, 'This gift better be good.'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, what about you? What do I get for the guy who has everything? Or, you know... The guy who has cheap, junky things.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like you said, it's no big deal. It's the thought that counts.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...It's not like these gifts are gonna make or break our relationship.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Right! Of course. So, no pressure.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No pressure.
The two of them step out of the car and make their way towards the mall entrance.
They begin to cross the street, when suddenly--
`SKKRRRTT!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SKKRRRTT!![/b]

nodes.text: A limousine comes screeching to a halt, its bumper just inches away from Owen's knees!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa!
The back door opens, and a well dressed man steps out with a smug smile on his face...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I'm sorry, my friend! I didn't see you there...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Because I was in the backseat... Because I've hired a chauffer to drive for me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Cromwell.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cromwell.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Paige, my flower. Still consorting with `dirty weeds,` I see.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige, my flower. Still consorting with [color=#e23b3b][i]dirty weeds,[/i][/color] I see.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Keep talkin', Hedge Fund. You'll wish you traded that chauffer for a bodyguard.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: A Ha Ha! Such wit the common folk have!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing here, Cromwell? I already told you, there's `nothing` between us.
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing here, Cromwell? I already told you, there's [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing[/i][/color] between us.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Our meeting is happenstance, sweet Paige. You have come here shopping for cheap trinkets as holiday gifts, I assume.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And I have come shopping for businesses to expand my entrepreneurial ventures! What coincidence!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So you're here to gloat. I don't have time for this.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Nor I, truly. I'm planning to book a New Year's Eve cruise on the `S.S. Decadence.` Tickets are in short supply and high demand, so I must hurry off now.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nor I, truly. I'm planning to book a New Year's Eve cruise on the [color=#e23b3b][i]S.S. Decadence.[/i][/color] Tickets are in short supply and high demand, so I must hurry off now.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Maybe I'll see you two there! ...Though I very much doubt it, because I suspect you lack the funds! A Ha Ha!
Cromwell returns to his limo and rides off, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That spoiled little...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Forget about him. Look, I'll meet you back here this afternoon, and we'll exchange gifts then.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right. Sounds good.
Later, Paige walks into a trendy little boutique in the mall, where she approaches the clerk at the counter.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: How can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I hear your specialty is trading in vintage and secondhand clothes?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: That's correct. Are you interested in trading some items?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um. A few, yeah.
Paige takes off her backpack and empties its contents, spilling a cascade of clothes out onto the counter.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: These are the best pieces of my `old` wardrobe. I don't wear them much anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: These are the best pieces of my [color=#3b78e2][i]old[/i][/color] wardrobe. I don't wear them much anymore.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: I can see that. It's a much different style from your current look.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tell me about it. I just need to sell as much of this as possible.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Trust me, sweetie, I know the feeling. Any particular reason for the urgency?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You... You got me a carburetor!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't believe it. I thought you hated my junky truck!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I do. But I know `you` love it, you dork.
nodes.text_bbcode: I do. But I know [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] love it, you dork.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks, Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But there's something you should know... I don't `have` my truck anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: But there's something you should know... I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] my truck anymore.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...`What?`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...[color=#3b78e2][i]What?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I actually sold it yesterday. So that I could afford to get you `this.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I actually sold it yesterday. So that I could afford to get you [color=#e23b3b][i]this.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen presents a small rectangular box. He flips open the lid, revealing a choker necklace sporting a brilliant crystal charm... In the shape of a skull.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh my gosh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I once thought that money and fancy things were a part of who you were... And that your rebel image was just an act to hide that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I was wrong. And I was wrong to judge you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're tough, and you're beautiful, whether you have money or not.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But, that said... You `still` deserve to have nice things.
nodes.text_bbcode: But, that said... You [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] deserve to have nice things.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, this is gorgeous...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...And awesome. This would go perfectly with the outfit...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...That I just sold so that I could buy your gift.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No way...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yup.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think I read a story where this happens. A guy and a girl, exchanging two very thoughtful, yet suddenly useless gifts...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess we'll have to settle for the knowledge that we both made sacrifices for each other.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pssh, please. Maybe at one time we would've had to settle...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...But baby, that's what `return policies` are for.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But baby, that's what [color=#3b78e2][i]return policies[/i][/color] are for.

nodes.text: Days later... On New Year's Eve!
Paige and Owen sip cold beverages on the deck of the `S.S. Decadence.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige and Owen sip cold beverages on the deck of the [b]S.S. Decadence.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm so glad we could use our gift money on something we could both enjoy.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're enjoying this now, take a look back to the dock!
The two approach the railing on the aft deck of the ship as the vessel pulls away from shore. There on the pier, Cromwell is arguing loudly with a port official.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What do you mean `sold out?!` Do you know who I am?! This is an outrage!
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you mean [color=#e23b3b][i]sold out?![/i][/color] Do you know who I am?! This is an outrage!

nodes.text: Owen and Paige wave to Cromwell as he fumes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry, friend! Short supply, high demand!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not bad for a couple of 'common folk', huh?
Owen pulls Paige close as the ship sails out to sea.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is definitely not where I thought I'd be a few months ago.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I wouldn't want to be anywhere else.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, kissing didn't exactly go how I wanted it to last time, but the countdown to midnight's coming up...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Forget` the countdown. I'm not waiting a second longer.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Forget[/i][/color] the countdown. I'm not waiting a second longer.

nodes.text: Paige throws her arms around Owen's neck and pulls him in for a long, sweet kiss!
Midnight comes and goes... But the two of them hardly notice.
Days after, the Troublemakers reunite for the first detention session after returning from Winter Break!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I can't wait to tell you all about my first visit to Santa's Village! There was tradition! And peppermint! And whimsy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've got stories as well! My first date with Delilah was one for the history books!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's great! I, uh... Think I have news for you guys too.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, we `both` do.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, we [color=#3b78e2][i]both[/i][/color] do.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmigosh, ohmigosh... Is it what I `think` it is?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmigosh, ohmigosh... Is it what I [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] it is?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Settle down, Troublemakers. `My` news takes priority over your teenage jibber-jabber.
nodes.text_bbcode: Settle down, Troublemakers. [color=#3b78e2][i]My[/i][/color] news takes priority over your teenage jibber-jabber.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: 'Jibber-jabber'?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm sorry to say what I'm about to say... But there's been a change in the Troublemakers program.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A change?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All of you will still be a part of the program...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: ...However, `I` won't be. To be honest, I'm sad to go, but it wasn't my choice.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...However, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] won't be. To be honest, I'm sad to go, but it wasn't my choice.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Effective immediately, you all have a `new` supervisor overseeing your community service.
nodes.text_bbcode: Effective immediately, you all have a [color=#3b78e2][i]new[/i][/color] supervisor overseeing your community service.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And off the record, if you think things were hard before...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: ...You ain't seen `nothing` yet.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...You ain't seen [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing[/i][/color] yet.

nodes.text: You have reached the end of `Season 2, Episode 6: Christmas Stories!`

Spencer and Kimi are sitting at a table near the dance floor.
Want me to get you something to drink?
Ha! Are you kidding me? You can barely walk. I'll go get us drinks.
I know you `could,` but `I'm` going to.
He looks out onto the dance floor and sees $ALLISON and Cameron dancing...
A moment later, Kimi returns with their drinks.
Well, if you didn't want one, you could have just said so!
What?! Oh, I... I didn't notice you were back.
I'm totally kidding with you. Does she know how you feel?
I don't! And I've gotta go do something!
Spencer gets up, hobbling away on his crutches!
But he keeps going, slamming through a side door...
Grrr! Why did I wait to ask her?! How could I be so dumb?!
He angrily throws his crutch across the room! It flies over some boxes and clatters into the corner, the farthest point from him.
Using his one crutch, he positions himself against the wall, scooting in between the stacks of boxes.
Dumbest dance of all time! So stupid--
He stops ranting when he reaches the window, noticing Cameron and $ALLISON outside, alone, together.
Cameron sweeps aside a lock of her hair...
Don't fall for it! Don't fall for it!
Then Cameron leans down, his hands holding her face...
His heart aching, Spencer resumes his quest for his lost crutch. He picks it up, trying not to look out the window... But he can't help sneaking one last glance...
He tries to race out of the room, but the door won't budge! It's locked!
He takes out his phone and sends a text to Erik. 'stuck in the storage room. tell ms lee. help $ALLISON. shes outside. dont tell her it was me.'
A moment later, he watches as Erik comes outside to talk to $ALLISON...
Thanks, buddy... Wish I could have been there.
What does this mean for $ALLISON, Cameron, and Spencer? And how will Erik's Thanksgiving with Delilah go?!
Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!

Want to see how Paige and Owen's Homecoming night `really` went?!
In a fancy, upscale Italian restaurant, Paige and Lee finish placing their orders.
So?! The waiters are wearing white, the chandeliers are crystal, and the people are `my` kind of people!
That you kind of... Didn't have any more money.
Well, yeah! But that's where you come in!
Your family `owns` Cowboy Burger! You should be able to afford a couple plates of linguini!
Right?! Since we `already placed our orders!`
...And don't get me started on what it's like dealing with Nicole!
She's always texting guys when she should be focused on her cheerleading routines!
Are you paying attention to me?!
Yeah, of course, but the movie is starting... I think you're disturbing some of the other movie-goers...
A person who likes to be able to focus on the movie?!
I never thought I'd actually meet one!
`I` never thought I'd actually meet someone who thought it was weird `not` to talk during movies!
The guy sitting directly in front of them whirls around!
Shh! I'm trying to enjoy the cinema!
The guy stands up, glaring back at them!
Yeah, right! My date's a football player, he's not scared of you!
The guy holds up a humongous container of soda and takes a deep, menacing sip.
Paige and Lee have been forced to do dishes!
Really glad we left the dance for this!
Forgive me for assuming you actually had a dime of your family's money!
Lee slams a plate down on the counter!
You know, it's one thing to use me to try and make Owen jealous...
It's another to use my money for... For whatever feeling you're trying to capture tonight.
I know we haven't spent that much time together, but I know you're better than this.
As Paige scrubs another dish, she can't help but think of Owen, and all the fun he's having...
You didn't do anything to that guy!
What was I supposed to do?! We were in the wrong!
I don't know what that means, but you're supposed to stick up for me!
Well, maybe this is a lesson. Don't talk during movies!
I don't even understand why you took me to the dance!
Especially if we were just going to leave! You know, my friends were all there!
I don't really know what I was thinking either...
As Owen steps into his car, he can't help but think of Paige, and all the fun she's having...

In a small house in Centerscore, a young mother knocks on her son's door...
Something came for you from the toy store for the holidays.
She reveals a present that she'd been hiding behind her back...
I got a gift?! Can I open it now?
Yes, but only if you `get up!`
Elmo hops out of bed, and she hands the present to him.
He unwraps it, revealing a brand-new video game console!
Really?! This is my gift?! How long do we have it for?!
Sometimes people are really `really` nice. And a bunch of really `really` nice people collected a bunch of money to do something nice for us.
He nods, giving her a big hug.
Can we play it right now?
We can play it after we get you some breakfast...
Can we give something to the really `really` nice people too?
That's very nice of you. We can't do that because we don't know who they are or where they live... But we can tell the toy store to say 'thank you' for us.
Okay, let's do that. And tell them if they know where `we` live, that they can play too.
We'll make sure to let them know. Now come on, lazy boy! Come get your breakfast.
He giggles, running out of the room!

nodes.text: Finally, Cameron pulls back, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Wow.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah. Wow.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If that's what kissing's like, I'm going to be doing it much more frequently!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It was a good kiss.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: ...But when I get back, maybe we should work quietly.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Horner
nodes.text: Talking's not really your thing, boy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, sir.
He turns and leaves the barn, his pail sloshing heavily with milk. Erik pets the cow in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry you had to witness that awkwardness, Penelope.
Paige hurls the shoe at the black-cherry car...
...And it connects with the middle of the trunk, popping it open, exposing the stolen consoles!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You did it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I did it! I can't believe I did it!
Almost immediately, the police car breaks away from Owen and Paige and merges behind the black-cherry car!
As Owen and Paige pass, they can see the looks on all the guy's faces.
Owen shouts out the window!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sucks to be you right now, doesn't it?!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Grr!
As Sal gets pulled over, Owen and Paige continue on the freeway, no one following them, back toward home...
You are now playing as Owen.
Later that night, back in Grandma Betty's kitchen...
Grandma Betty is serving both Owen and Paige some hot chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Well, it sounds like both of you had quite a night!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... Yes... We did...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I'm just glad my Owie's okay. And that you're okay too, sweetie!
The doorbell rings! Police lights cast a blue glow against the lace curtains!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The cops!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Let me handle this.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma, you shouldn't have to deal with this, I mean, you're--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: An old coot who doesn't have any bats in her belfry?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not exactly what I was gonna say...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I've got more bats than you know! Let me handle this.
Grandma Betty shuffles toward the front door, takes a breath, and opens it. Paige and Owen stand beside her.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Evening, Betty.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Monte-Carlos.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm terribly sorry to disturb you at such a late hour...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But your vehicle was involved in a high-speed chase on the freeway this evening!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I have reason to believe your grandson was the driver! Now, I'm going to have to place him under arrest and take him in.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Owie, why don't you tell Monte what happened?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ma'am, that's not--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: --Don't interrupt me, young man! I knew you when you were stumbling around in diapers! Owie, tell him what happened!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I went down there with the guys. They blackmailed me into driving for them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If I hadn't, they would have hurt my grandmother.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's no excuse for the recklessness you displayed tonight!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, it isn't. But I really felt like I had no other options! If I hadn't done anything, they would have gotten away!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Isn't that something you can relate to, Officer?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: All the time, miss! That's the life of a policeman, day in and day out! But that still doesn't change the fact that protocol states I have to--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: To the dump with your protocol, Monte-Carlos!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I know every bad thing you've ever done, and I know every good thing my grandson's done!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I know right from wrong, and I know both of you are `good` people!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know right from wrong, and I know both of you are [color=#3b78e2][i]good[/i][/color] people!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, the law...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: The law says that you have to put criminals behind bars... Now have you done that tonight?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am we apprehended some suspects.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Good. You've done your job. Now, I'm going to give you some spaghetti to take home and then I'm going to go to bed.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Now how does that sit with you?
Monte holds his hat in his hands, thinking...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just fine, ma'am.
A short time later, Grandma Betty closes the door on a satisfied Officer Monte, a container of spaghetti under his arm.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You can come out now, children. The coast is clear.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, that was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I will never underestimate you again.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Nothing to it. Now, it's far too late for an old woman like me to be up. Good night, you two.
She shuffles off toward the bedroom.
As soon as she's gone, Owen smiles at Paige and brings her in for a kiss...
But she resists, backing away!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Since when?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, kissing you is great, but that's what we `always` do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, kissing you is great, but that's what we [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nothing's changed! I still don't know `what we are.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing's changed! I still don't know [color=#3b78e2][i]what we are.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're... Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Urg! Boys! Never mind! Bye! Again!
Paige stomps out of the house. Owen closes the door, confused. His grandma shuffles toward him down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Are you an idiot?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I heard your little fight. Go after her, you dingus!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think she wants to talk...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: She came back for you before. That's how she knew you were gone. Don't you get it, Owie...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: ...She loves you!
Owen smiles, realizing how blind he's been...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks, Grandma!
He rushes out of the house!
Owen reaches the bus stop...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry! I'm an idiot! I'm a dingus.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you also from the 1950's?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I want to talk about us. I want to talk about what we are.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...I don't know. The last bus is going to come any minute...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's okay, you don't need the bus...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll drive you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I did it! I can't believe I did it!
Almost immediately, the police car breaks away from Owen and Paige and merges behind the black-cherry car!
As Owen and Paige pass, they can see the looks on all the guy's faces.
Owen shouts out the window!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sucks to be you right now, doesn't it?!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Grr!
As Sal gets pulled over, Owen and Paige continue on the freeway, no one following them, back toward home...
You are now playing as Owen.
Later that night, back in Grandma Betty's kitchen...
Grandma Betty is serving both Owen and Paige some hot chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Well, it sounds like both of you had quite a night!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... Yes... We did...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I'm just glad my Owie's okay. And that you're okay too, sweetie!
The doorbell rings! Police lights cast a blue glow against the lace curtains!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The cops!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Let me handle this.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma, you shouldn't have to deal with this, I mean, you're--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: An old coot who doesn't have any bats in her belfry?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not exactly what I was gonna say...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I've got more bats than you know! Let me handle this.
Grandma Betty shuffles toward the front door, takes a breath, and opens it. Paige and Owen stand beside her.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Evening, Betty.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Monte-Carlos.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm terribly sorry to disturb you at such a late hour...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But your vehicle was involved in a high-speed chase on the freeway this evening!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I have reason to believe your grandson was the driver! Now, I'm going to have to place him under arrest and take him in.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Owie, why don't you tell Monte what happened?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ma'am, that's not--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: --Don't interrupt me, young man! I knew you when you were stumbling around in diapers! Owie, tell him what happened!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I went down there with the guys. They blackmailed me into driving for them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If I hadn't, they would have hurt my grandmother.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That's no excuse for the recklessness you displayed tonight!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, it isn't. But I really felt like I had no other options! If I hadn't done anything, they would have gotten away!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Isn't that something you can relate to, Officer?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: All the time, miss! That's the life of a policeman, day in and day out! But that still doesn't change the fact that protocol states I have to--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: To the dump with your protocol, Monte-Carlos!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I know every bad thing you've ever done, and I know every good thing my grandson's done!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I know right from wrong, and I know both of you are `good` people!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know right from wrong, and I know both of you are [color=#3b78e2][i]good[/i][/color] people!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, the law...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: The law says that you have to put criminals behind bars... Now have you done that tonight?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am we apprehended some suspects.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Good. You've done your job. Now, I'm going to give you some spaghetti to take home and then I'm going to go to bed.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Now how does that sit with you?
Monte holds his hat in his hands, thinking...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just fine, ma'am.
A short time later, Grandma Betty closes the door on a satisfied Officer Monte, a container of spaghetti under his arm.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You can come out now, children. The coast is clear.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, that was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I will never underestimate you again.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Nothing to it. Now, it's far too late for an old woman like me to be up. Good night, you two.
She shuffles off toward the bedroom.
As soon as she's gone, Owen smiles at Paige and brings her in for a kiss...
But she resists, backing away!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Since when?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, kissing you is great, but that's what we `always` do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, kissing you is great, but that's what we [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nothing's changed! I still don't know `what we are.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing's changed! I still don't know [color=#3b78e2][i]what we are.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We're... Paige and Owen.

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards).
